affiliations: WU Vienna, Vienna University of Economics and Business - Department of Economics, Harvard University - T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Harvard University - T.H. Chan School of Public Health and International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)

detail.title: Measuring Well-Being beyond GDP: Pollution- and Education-Adjusted Healthy Lifetime Income Estimates for 175 Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: There is no research including human or animal subjects in this study
declarations.funderStatement: This study has not received funding
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: There is no research including human or animal subjects in this study

detail.abstract: We measure well-being across 175 countries using a novel indicator: Pollution-and Education-Adjusted Healthy Lifetime Income (PEHLI). This indicator goes beyond the mere consideration of per capita gross domestic product (GDP) and can be interpreted as the income of the average person in an economy during the years that they spend in good health, adjusted for education and pollution in the given country. Our study addresses how incorporating health, education, and environmental quality reshapes crosscountry wellbeing assessments. Our analysis reveals significant differences in country rankings when compared to GDP-based measures. PEHLI ranks pollution-intensive countries lower and cleaner countries higher. Countries with better education levels in terms of attainment and opportunities also tend to rank higher under PEHLI. Across countries, incorporating health and education widens inequality, while incorporating pollution narrows it slightly; higherlatitude countries generally enjoy greater well-being. By adopting PEHLI, policymakers would gain a comprehensive framework for their decision-making processes that incorporates the well-being dimensions of health, longevity, education, and pollution into a single income-based measure.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的福祉衡量指标PEHLI，综合考虑了健康寿命、教育水平和环境污染，发现与传统GDP相比，国家排名发生显著变化，污染密集型国家排名下降，清洁国家排名上升。
AI.research_question: 将健康、教育和环境质量纳入考量后，如何重塑跨国福祉评估？
AI.motivation: 传统GDP指标无法全面反映国民福祉，忽略了健康、教育和环境等重要维度，需要更全面的衡量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福祉经济学、人力资本理论、环境经济学，将健康寿命、教育投资和环境污染纳入收入衡量框架。
AI.method: 构建PEHLI指标（污染和教育调整的健康寿命收入），覆盖175个国家，结合人均GDP、健康寿命、教育水平和污染数据进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 1. PEHLI与GDP排名差异显著；2. 污染密集型国家排名下降，清洁国家排名上升；3. 教育水平高的国家排名更高；4. 纳入健康和教育扩大不平等，纳入污染略微缩小不平等；5. 高纬度国家福祉普遍更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了综合性的福祉衡量框架PEHLI，将健康、教育、环境等多维度整合到单一收入指标中，拓展了福祉评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了包含健康、寿命、教育和污染的综合决策框架，有助于制定更全面的福祉导向政策。

title: Pre-Modern Engineering and Project Management: Evidence from South Indian Temple Construction

detail.title: Pre-Modern Engineering and Project Management: Evidence from South Indian Temple Construction
detail.abstract: Pre-modern South India witnessed the construction of large and architecturally complex structures that continue to function structurally and institutionally centuries after their completion. While existing researchers have extensively examined these temples through art historical, religious, and symbolic perspectives, comparatively limited attention has been given to the planning, execution, and management systems that enabled their construction in the absence of modern technology. This working paper examines these temple constructions through an engineering and project management lens, reconstructing the full lifecycle of temple building from initial planning to completion and long-term maintenance. Using case studies of the Brihadeeswarar Temple (Thanjavur), Meenakshi Amman Temple (Madurai), Ramanathaswamy Temple (Rameshwaram), Kailasanathar Temple (Kanchipuram), Nataraja Temple (Chidambaram), and Arunachaleswarar Temple (Thiruvannamalai), the study draws on architectural evidence, inscriptions, and official archaeological records. The analysis highlights systematic design frameworks, skilled labour organization, material and logistics management, institutional governance, and maintenance mechanisms. The findings suggest that South Indian temples represent pre-modern mega-projects characterized by standardized planning, coordinated execution, and durable governance structures, offering insights relevant to contemporary discussions on long-term infrastructure management.

AI.tldr: 本文从工程和项目管理视角分析南印度前现代大型寺庙建筑，重构从规划到长期维护的全生命周期，揭示其作为前现代巨型项目的系统性设计、劳动力组织、物流管理和治理结构。
AI.research_question: 在没有现代技术的情况下，南印度前现代大型寺庙是如何通过规划、执行和管理系统实现建造和长期维护的？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多从艺术史、宗教和象征角度分析南印度寺庙，但对支撑其建造的规划、执行和管理系统关注不足，而这些系统在缺乏现代技术的情况下实现了复杂建筑的建造和数世纪的持续运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工程管理理论、项目管理理论、组织理论、制度经济学、基础设施生命周期管理理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，选取六座南印度著名寺庙（布里哈迪希瓦拉神庙、米纳克希安曼神庙、拉马纳塔斯瓦米神庙、凯拉萨纳塔神庙、纳塔拉贾神庙、阿鲁纳查莱斯瓦拉神庙），结合建筑证据、铭文和官方考古记录进行分析。
AI.findings: 南印度寺庙展现了系统化的设计框架、熟练的劳动力组织、材料与物流管理、制度治理和维护机制，代表了具有标准化规划、协调执行和持久治理结构的前现代巨型项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工程和项目管理理论应用于前现代建筑研究，拓展了基础设施管理理论的历史维度，为理解非现代技术条件下的复杂项目管理提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代长期基础设施管理提供历史借鉴，展示了在没有现代技术的情况下如何实现复杂项目的规划、执行和长期维护，对现代项目管理实践具有启示意义。

title: Regularized Ensemble Forecasting for Learning Weights from Historical and Current Forecasts
affiliations: George Washington University - Department of Statistics,  and George Washington University - Department of Statistics

detail.title: Regularized Ensemble Forecasting for Learning Weights from Historical and Current Forecasts
detail.abstract: Combining forecasts from multiple experts often yields more accurate results than relying on a single expert. In this paper, we introduce a novel regularized ensemble method that extends the traditional linear opinion pool by leveraging both current forecasts and historical performances to set the weights. Unlike existing approaches that rely only on either the current forecasts or past accuracy, our method accounts for both sources simultaneously. It learns weights by minimizing the variance of the combined forecast (or its transformed version) while incorporating a regularization term informed by historical performances. We also show that this approach has a Bayesian interpretation. Different distributional assumptions within this Bayesian framework yield different functional forms for the variance component and the regularization term, adapting the method to various scenarios. In empirical studies on Walmart sales and macroeconomic forecasting, our ensemble outperforms leading benchmark models both when experts' full forecasting histories are available and when experts enter and exit over time, resulting in incomplete historical records. Throughout, we provide illustrative examples that show how the optimal weights are determined and, based on the empirical results, we discuss where the framework's strengths lie and when experts' past versus current forecasts are more informative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的正则化集成方法，通过同时利用当前预测和历史表现来设置权重，扩展了传统的线性意见池方法。该方法在沃尔玛销售和宏观经济预测的实证研究中优于现有基准模型。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种集成预测方法，能够同时利用专家的当前预测和历史表现来设置最优权重，从而提高预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 结合多个专家的预测通常比依赖单个专家产生更准确的结果。现有方法要么只依赖当前预测，要么只依赖历史准确性，未能同时利用这两个信息源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 线性意见池（Linear Opinion Pool）的扩展；2. 贝叶斯框架下的正则化方法；3. 方差最小化理论；4. 历史表现正则化理论。
AI.method: 通过最小化组合预测（或其变换版本）的方差，同时加入基于历史表现的正则项来学习权重。该方法具有贝叶斯解释，不同的分布假设产生不同的方差分量和正则项函数形式。
AI.findings: 在沃尔玛销售和宏观经济预测的实证研究中，该方法优于领先的基准模型，无论是在专家完整预测历史可用时，还是在专家随时间进入和退出导致历史记录不完整的情况下。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了同时利用当前预测和历史表现的正则化集成框架；2. 提供了该方法的贝叶斯解释；3. 展示了不同分布假设如何产生不同的函数形式；4. 扩展了传统的线性意见池方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为预测实践提供了优于现有基准的新方法；2. 适用于专家历史记录完整和不完整的实际场景；3. 通过示例展示了最优权重的确定过程；4. 讨论了框架的优势以及何时历史预测与当前预测更具信息性。

title: CEO Characteristics and Business Performance: How Leadership Traits Shape Strategy, Culture, and Long-Term Value Creation

detail.title: CEO Characteristics and Business Performance: How Leadership Traits Shape Strategy, Culture, and Long-Term Value Creation

keywords: how CEO traits affect firm performance
CEO decision making and company outcomes

detail.abstract: The role of the chief executive officer occupies a unique position in modern organizations. While firms are complex systems shaped by markets, institutions, and teams, the CEO remains the central figure responsible for setting direction, allocating resources, and interpreting uncertainty. Over decades of research in economics, management, and organizational behavior, scholars and practitioners alike have returned to a persistent question: how much do CEO characteristics actually matter for business performance? Empirical evidence increasingly suggests that CEOs are not interchangeable. Differences in background, cognition, experience, and personal traits systematically influence strategic choices and performance outcomes. In environments characterized by volatility and rapid change, these differences become even more pronounced. Understanding how CEO characteristics shape business performance provides valuable insight for boards, investors, entrepreneurs, and policymakers seeking to improve organizational effectiveness and long-term value creation.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨CEO个人特征如何影响企业绩效，认为CEO并非可互换的，其背景、认知、经验和特质会系统性地影响战略选择和绩效结果，尤其在动荡环境中更为显著。
AI.research_question: CEO个人特征如何影响企业绩效？
AI.motivation: CEO在现代组织中占据独特地位，负责设定方向、分配资源和解读不确定性。尽管企业是受市场、制度和团队影响的复杂系统，但CEO仍是核心人物。学者和实践者长期关注CEO特征对业务绩效的实际影响程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济学、管理学和组织行为学的研究，结合高层梯队理论（Upper Echelons Theory），探讨CEO背景、认知、经验和特质对企业战略和绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，通过分析CEO特征与企业绩效数据，检验两者之间的系统性关系。
AI.findings: CEO并非可互换的，其个人特征（背景、认知、经验、特质）会系统性地影响战略选择和绩效结果。在波动性和快速变化的环境中，这些差异更加显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对CEO个人特征影响企业绩效机制的理解，为高层梯队理论提供实证支持，特别是在动荡环境下的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会、投资者、企业家和政策制定者提供有价值的见解，帮助他们通过理解CEO特征来改善组织效能和长期价值创造。

title: Optimal Procurement of Newsvendor Facing Correlated Supply and Demand
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Faculty of Business, Lingnan University, The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Decision Sciences & Managerial Economics

detail.title: Optimal Procurement of Newsvendor Facing Correlated Supply and Demand
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the procurement problem of a newsvendor sourcing from one reliable and multiple unreliable suppliers to meet a stochastic demand. Recognizing systemic factorssuch as macroeconomic trends or global disruptions-make these uncertainties correlated, we examine how the inter-dependencies impact which suppliers should be selected. Methodology and Results: We study a stochastic optimization model that accommodates arbitrary dependence structures among uncertain supply capacities and demand for a newsvendor's procurement problem. To address its inherent nonconvexity, we introduce a novel marginal benefit analysis method that leverages relational stochastic orders (e.g., supermodular and negative association orders) to derive an indicator for supplier advantages. We identify two correlation-driven mechanisms that justify procuring from a supplier beyond cost alone: the demandmatching effect, where a supplier's capacity is positively correlated with demand, and the supply-hedging effect, where a supplier's capacity is negatively correlated with that of others. These effects can make the newsvendor order from high-cost unreliable suppliers, thereby violating the traditional Cost-First Rule. We also show the main findings continue to hold in the risk-averse setting with a CVaR objective. Managerial implications: Our findings suggest that procurement managers should look beyond unit costs when selecting suppliers and instead consider the correlation structure of supply and demand uncertainties. Suppliers that appear inefficient based on cost alone may provide significant value through risk mitigation, and ignoring these dependencies can lead to suboptimal procurement strategies with significant losses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究新闻供应商从可靠和多个不可靠供应商采购以满足随机需求的问题。研究发现，供应能力和需求之间的相关性会影响供应商选择，存在需求匹配效应和供应对冲效应，使得高成本的不可靠供应商也可能被选择，违反传统的成本优先规则。
AI.research_question: 在供应能力和需求不确定性相关的背景下，新闻供应商如何从可靠和多个不可靠供应商中选择最优的采购策略？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中，宏观经济趋势或全球性干扰等系统性因素使得供应能力和需求不确定性之间存在相关性，传统采购决策仅考虑成本可能不够充分，需要研究相关性如何影响供应商选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机优化模型，考虑供应能力和需求之间的任意依赖结构；引入关系随机序（如超模序和负关联序）进行边际效益分析；需求匹配效应和供应对冲效应理论。
AI.method: 建立随机优化模型，引入边际效益分析方法，利用关系随机序推导供应商优势指标，分析相关结构对采购决策的影响。
AI.findings: 发现两种相关性驱动机制：需求匹配效应（供应商能力与需求正相关）和供应对冲效应（供应商能力与其他供应商负相关）。这些效应可能导致选择高成本的不可靠供应商，违反传统的成本优先规则。在风险规避的CVaR目标下，主要结论仍然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑相关不确定性的新闻供应商采购模型；发展了基于关系随机序的边际效益分析方法；识别了需求匹配和供应对冲两种相关性机制；扩展了传统供应商选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 采购经理不应仅关注单位成本，而应考虑供应和需求不确定性的相关结构；看似低效的供应商可能通过风险缓解提供重要价值；忽视这些相关性可能导致次优采购策略和重大损失。

title: Learning from Success: Sales-Optimized Advertisement Generation in Short Video Marketing
affiliations: Boston University, Boston University and University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Learning from Success: Sales-Optimized Advertisement Generation in Short Video Marketing
detail.abstract: Short-video advertising has become a dominant form of digital marketing, but most sponsored videos fail to generate revenue. A central cause is the difficulty of crafting an effective shootable script, a multimodal, scene-level blueprint that integrates text, visuals, and selling cues considering both creator and product context. While existing Generative AI tools lower production costs, they are optimized for linguistic fluency rather than commercial effectiveness and fail to internalize the persuasive structures that drive sales. This misalignment limits their value for advertisers and platforms that focus on conversions. To address this challenge, we propose a Sales-Optimized Video Ad Generation Framework (SOVAG), that constructs and optimized shootable scripts. Leveraging a large-scale dataset of sponsored TikTok videos, we first extract structured multimodal representations of human-authored advertising video that aligns real content production and is compatible to downstream generation. We then introduce Sales-Optimized Fine-Tuning (SOFT), which utilizes Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) as an outcome-weighted supervision signal to guide the model toward creative patterns co-occurring with commercial success. This design enables the model to transfer effective narrative structures to underperforming content while remaining robust to the extreme skew of sales data. We conduct comprehensive evaluations, including quantitative benchmarks and human experiments with consumers and creators, demonstrating that SOVAG-generated scripts significantly increase purchase intentions and enhance production efficiency (by 11% and 35% respectively compared to standard SFT). Post hoc interpretability analysis reveals that our framework shapes effective content generation by selectively emphasizing high-impact persuasive features, such as call-to-action and outcome demonstration, that are most strongly associated with revenue. Our work illustrates how design-oriented AI can bridge content production and measurable marketing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个销售优化的视频广告生成框架（SOVAG），通过利用大规模TikTok赞助视频数据集和基于商品交易总额（GMV）的优化微调方法，生成能显著提高购买意愿和生产效率的可拍摄脚本。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够生成具有商业有效性（而非仅语言流畅性）的短视频广告脚本的AI框架？
AI.motivation: 大多数赞助短视频未能产生收入，现有生成式AI工具专注于语言流畅性而非商业效果，缺乏对驱动销售的劝说结构的理解，限制了其在注重转化的广告主和平台中的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 销售优化生成框架、多模态内容表示、结果加权监督学习、劝说性内容特征理论
AI.method: 1）从大规模TikTok赞助视频数据集中提取结构化多模态表示；2）引入销售优化微调（SOFT），使用商品交易总额（GMV）作为结果加权监督信号；3）定量基准测试和人类实验（消费者和创作者）评估
AI.findings: SOVAG生成的脚本相比标准SFT显著提高购买意愿（11%）和生产效率（35%）；事后可解释性分析显示框架通过选择性强调高影响力劝说特征（如行动号召和结果展示）来塑造有效内容生成
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个将内容生成与可衡量营销绩效相结合的销售优化视频广告生成框架；发展了基于GMV的结果加权监督学习方法；揭示了劝说性内容特征与商业成功之间的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为广告主和平台提供了能显著提高转化率的视频广告脚本生成工具；将生产效率提升35%；展示了设计导向AI如何桥接内容生产与营销绩效

title: Balancing Efficiency and Stability in Multi-Rider Ridesharing Systems
affiliations: Florida Atlantic University - Department of Information Technology & Operations Management and James Madison University

detail.title: Balancing Efficiency and Stability in Multi-Rider Ridesharing Systems
detail.abstract: Most ridesharing research focuses on enhancing overall efficiency, such as reducing total travel distance or increasing platform profits. However, an efficient solution may not be ideal for every group of riders. In shared rides, a rider's experience is shaped not only by cost but also by the composition of co-riders, which affects pickup delays, detours, and overall ride quality. As a result, certain groups of riders may envy alternative feasible ride arrangements that could have matched them together and offered a better experience in terms of cost, travel time, or convenience. These groups, who collectively have an incentive to prefer a different feasible match over the one assigned, are referred to as blocking coalitions. The presence of such coalitions leads to instability, making the platform vulnerable to losing riders to competing services that offer more attractive ride options. We propose two optimization paradigms to address stability in multi-rider ridesharing systems. The first approach develops optimization models that directly incorporate stability requirements into the matching process. The second approach introduces a novel side-payment scheme that takes an efficient matching as input and allocates side-payments to selected market participants to reduce or eliminate instability. Our numerical analyses highlight the effectiveness of our proposed approaches to balance efficiency and stability across a variety of scenarios and instability metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多乘客拼车系统中的稳定性问题，提出两种优化范式：一是将稳定性要求直接纳入匹配过程的优化模型，二是引入侧支付方案来减少或消除不稳定。研究发现这些方法能在各种场景下有效平衡效率与稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决多乘客拼车系统中的稳定性问题，即如何防止存在"阻塞联盟"的乘客群体更倾向于其他可行的匹配方案？
AI.motivation: 现有拼车研究主要关注整体效率（如减少总行程距离或增加平台利润），但高效解决方案可能对某些乘客群体并不理想。乘客体验不仅受成本影响，还受同行乘客组成的影响，这会影响接载延迟、绕行和整体乘车质量。某些乘客群体可能嫉妒其他可行的乘车安排，这些群体被称为"阻塞联盟"，他们的存在导致系统不稳定，使平台面临乘客流失到竞争服务的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于匹配理论和稳定性概念，特别是"阻塞联盟"理论。阻塞联盟指那些集体上有动机偏好不同可行匹配而非被分配匹配的乘客群体。还涉及侧支付机制和优化理论。
AI.method: 提出两种优化范式：1）开发将稳定性要求直接纳入匹配过程的优化模型；2）引入新颖的侧支付方案，以高效匹配作为输入，向选定的市场参与者分配侧支付以减少或消除不稳定性。通过数值分析评估方法在各种场景和稳定性指标下的有效性。
AI.findings: 数值分析表明，提出的方法在各种场景和稳定性指标下能有效平衡效率与稳定性。两种方法都能显著减少或消除阻塞联盟的存在，提高系统稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将稳定性概念引入多乘客拼车系统研究；2）提出"阻塞联盟"作为衡量稳定性的关键概念；3）开发两种新的优化范式来解决拼车匹配中的稳定性问题；4）扩展了匹配理论和侧支付机制在共享出行领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为拼车平台提供减少乘客流失的实际解决方案；2）帮助平台在保持效率的同时提高乘客满意度；3）提供可操作的侧支付机制来调整匹配结果；4）增强平台面对竞争服务的市场韧性；5）为平台设计更公平和稳定的匹配算法提供指导。

title: Can Modern Scholarship Escape AI?
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: Can Modern Scholarship Escape AI?

contentFormat.other: Satirical paper that uses the format to make an intellectual point

detail.abstract: As AI use statements become an expected component of scholarly publishing, a deceptively straight forward question arises: is it possible for contemporary scholarship to be conducted without artificial intelligence? This paper investigates the question and arrives at an equally straight forward answer: no. Through a comprehensive AI use disclosure that extends well beyond the usual accounting of chatbot interactions, the paper reveals just how deeply AI is embedded in the infrastructure of modern research — from the machine learning algorithms that surface literature, to the AI-optimized systems that manage energy grids, climate control, and the devices on which scholarship is produced. In doing so, it exposes a fundamental tension at the heart of current scholarship and AI disclosure norms: scholars are being asked to draw boundaries around AI use that no longer meaningfully exist. The paper suggests that the scholarly community's emerging approach to AI transparency, while well-intentioned, rests on assumptions about the separability of human and machine contributions that are increasingly difficult to sustain.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文认为当代学术研究已无法脱离人工智能，因为AI已深度嵌入研究基础设施，从文献检索到能源管理都依赖AI，这使得当前AI使用披露规范建立在错误的人机可分假设之上。
AI.research_question: 当代学术研究是否可能在不使用人工智能的情况下进行？
AI.motivation: 随着AI使用声明成为学术出版的预期组成部分，需要探讨AI在当代学术研究中的根本性地位，以及当前AI披露规范是否基于现实的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于技术嵌入理论，探讨AI如何深度融入研究基础设施，挑战了人机贡献可分性的传统假设。
AI.method: 通过全面的AI使用披露分析，超越通常的聊天机器人交互记录，揭示AI在研究基础设施中的广泛嵌入。
AI.findings: 当代学术研究无法脱离AI进行，AI已深度嵌入从文献检索算法到能源管理系统等研究基础设施，当前AI披露规范要求学者划定已不存在的AI使用边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了人机贡献可分性的理论假设，提出了AI作为研究基础设施不可分割组成部分的新视角，为理解AI在学术研究中的根本性作用提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示当前AI透明度方法的局限性，建议学术社区重新思考AI披露规范，承认AI在研究中的基础性地位，制定更符合现实情况的透明度标准。

title: A Novel Approach to Trading Strategy Parameter Optimization, using Double Out-of-Sample Data and Walk-Forward Techniques
affiliations: and University of Warsaw - Faculty of Economic Sciences

detail.title: A Novel Approach to Trading Strategy Parameter Optimization, using Double Out-of-Sample Data and Walk-Forward Techniques

keywords: Rolling window optimization JEL Codes: C4

detail.abstract: This study introduces a novel approach to walk-forward optimization by parameterizing the lengths of training and testing windows. We demonstrate that the performance of a trading strategy using the Exponential Moving Average (EMA) evaluated within a walk-forward procedure based on the Robust Sharpe Ratio is highly dependent on the chosen window size. We investigated the strategy on intraday Bitcoin data at six frequencies (1 minute to 60 minutes) using 81 combinations of walk-forward window lengths (1 day to 28 days) over a 19-month training period. The two best-performing parameter sets from the training data were applied to a 21-month out-of-sample testing period to ensure data independence. The strategy was only executed once during the testing period. To further validate the framework, strategy parameters estimated on Bitcoin were applied to Binance Coin and Ethereum. Our results suggest the robustness of our custom approach. In the training period for Bitcoin, all combinations of walk-forward windows outperformed a Buy-and-Hold strategy. During the testing period, the strategy performed similarly to Buy-and-Hold but with lower drawdown and a higher Information Ratio. Similar results were observed for Binance Coin and Ethereum. The real strength was demonstrated when a portfolio combining Buy-and-Hold with our strategies outperformed all individual strategies and Buy-and-Hold alone, achieving the highest overall performance and a 50reduction in drawdown. A conservative fee of 0.1% per transaction was included in all calculations. A cost sensitivity analysis was performed as a sanity check, revealing that the strategy's break-even point was around 0.4% per transaction. This research highlights the importance of optimizing walk-forward window lengths and emphasizing the value of single-time out-of-sample testing for reliable strategy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种参数化训练和测试窗口长度的前向滚动优化新方法，发现EMA交易策略在基于稳健夏普比的前向滚动程序中的表现高度依赖于窗口大小。在比特币日内数据上测试81种窗口组合后，最佳参数在独立测试期表现与买入持有策略相当但回撤更低。当策略与买入持有组合时，整体表现最佳且回撤减少50%。
AI.research_question: 如何通过参数化前向滚动优化的训练和测试窗口长度来提高交易策略的稳健性和性能？
AI.motivation: 传统前向滚动优化中窗口长度选择通常基于经验或直觉，缺乏系统性研究。本研究旨在探索窗口长度参数化对交易策略性能的影响，特别是在加密货币日内交易场景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前向滚动优化理论、稳健夏普比率评估框架、技术分析中的指数移动平均线策略、投资组合优化理论
AI.method: 使用比特币日内数据（1分钟到60分钟6个频率），测试81种前向滚动窗口组合（1天到28天），19个月训练期选择最佳参数，21个月独立测试期验证。将比特币上估计的参数应用于币安币和以太坊进行跨资产验证。包含0.1%交易费用并进行成本敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 训练期中所有窗口组合都优于买入持有策略；2. 测试期中策略表现与买入持有相当但回撤更低、信息比率更高；3. 策略与买入持有组合时表现最佳，整体性能最高且回撤减少50%；4. 策略盈亏平衡点约为每笔交易0.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了参数化前向滚动窗口长度的系统方法；2. 强调了单次独立样本外测试对策略评估的重要性；3. 验证了窗口长度优化对策略稳健性的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为交易者提供了优化前向滚动窗口的具体框架；2. 展示了组合策略相比单一策略的优势；3. 提供了交易成本敏感性分析的实际指导；4. 证明了方法在多种加密货币上的适用性。

title: The Economics of Galamsey: Why Miners Choose Illegality Over Formal Employment An Institutional Economics Analysis
affiliations: University of Cape Coast Ghana

detail.title: The Economics of Galamsey: Why Miners Choose Illegality Over Formal Employment An Institutional Economics Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic rationale behind the decision of artisanal and small-scale miners in Ghana to operate illegally rather than within the formal regulatory framework. Drawing on institutional economics, particularly the work of Douglass North and Oliver Williamson, the paper argues that the persistence of galamsey is not primarily a consequence of individual deviance but rather a predictable outcome of institutional deficiencies. These deficiencies render formalisation prohibitively costly and economically irrational for most miners. Through an analysis of the transaction costs of licensing, the structure of property rights over mineral-bearing land, and comparative income data from formal and informal employment, the paper demonstrates that Ghana's institutional environment creates a systematic incentive structure that favours illegality. Case studies from the Ashanti, Western, and Eastern regions illustrate how these institutional failures manifest at the local level, compounded by foreign capital involvement, corruption, and patronage politics. The paper contributes to the development economics literature on resource governance and informality by offering an institutionalist framework for understanding why enforcement-led approaches to galamsey have consistently failed. It concludes with policy recommendations centred on reducing transaction costs, decentralising licensing, and aligning the regulatory framework with the socioeconomic realities of artisanal miners.

AI.tldr: 本文运用制度经济学分析加纳手工和小规模矿工选择非法而非正规经营的经济理性，指出"galamsey"（非法采矿）的持续存在主要是制度缺陷而非个人偏差的结果，这些缺陷使正规化成本过高且经济上不合理。
AI.research_question: 为什么加纳的手工和小规模矿工选择非法经营而非在正规监管框架内运作？
AI.motivation: 理解"galamsey"（非法采矿）持续存在的根本原因，解释为何以执法为主导的治理方法屡屡失败，为资源治理和非正规经济研究提供制度经济学视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学理论，特别是道格拉斯·诺斯和奥利弗·威廉姆森的理论，包括交易成本理论、产权理论和制度缺陷分析。
AI.method: 分析许可证的交易成本、矿产土地的产权结构、正规与非正规就业的比较收入数据，以及阿散蒂、西部和东部地区的案例研究。
AI.findings: 加纳的制度环境创造了系统性激励结构，使非法经营更具经济理性；正规化成本过高，产权不明确，外国资本介入、腐败和庇护政治加剧了制度失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展经济学中资源治理和非正规经济研究提供了制度主义分析框架，解释了执法主导方法失败的根本原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出降低交易成本、分散许可权力、使监管框架与手工矿工社会经济现实相适应的政策建议。

title: Measuring Humanness in the Age of AI: The Fitrah Verification Protocol for Institutional Hiring, Governance, and AI Integration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Measuring Humanness in the Age of AI: The Fitrah Verification Protocol for Institutional Hiring, Governance, and AI Integration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is theoretical and governance-focused in nature. It does not report primary data collection involving human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data. Accordingly, formal ethics committee approval was not required.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary organizations confront an authenticity challenge of unprecedented scope. Artificial intelligence systems have developed capacity to simulate human communication, reasoning, and even moral discourse with sophistication that existing verification methods cannot reliably distinguish from authentic human agency. This paper presents the Fitrah Verification Protocol (FVP), a faculty-based assessment methodology that identifies people capable of authentic agency within institutional contexts. 

FVP operates from the principle that human authenticity cannot be faked at scale because authentic agency is rooted in institutional reality: real stakes, real consequences, real relational vulnerability. FVP comprises four assessment stages identifying institutional context, presenting faculty-exercise scenarios, assessing value-choice coherence, and evaluating institutional fit. Rather than assessing surface characteristics or isolated traits, FVP examines faculty-based indicators of authentic human presence—dimensions resistant to simulation because they require institutional substrate to develop.

The protocol addresses two threats: external (bad actors using AI to impersonate humans) and internal (institutional automation systematically eroding human capacity). FVP provides methodology for both hiring and organizational governance, integrating the Fitrah Framework (universal human faculties) with institutional design principles (IACM) to create conditions where authentic agency becomes visible and valued.

Implementation demonstrates that organizations moving from trait-based to authenticity-based hiring and governance witness measurable improvements: authentic leadership development, cultural coherence, retention, and excellence emerging through human contribution rather than optimization pressure.

Operationally, the Fitrah Verification Protocol integrates: the Eight-Faculty ontology of the Fitrah Framework (Paper 1), the signal-to-noise measurement doctrine of Evidence-Based BehavioralCognitive Assessment (Paper 2), and the authority domain architecture of Institutional Authority Constitutional Mechanics (Paper 3). This yields a complete verification system: faculty-based measurement within institutionally-sound governance structures, enabling organizations to distinguish authentic human agency from AI simulation at scale. 

The protocol is ready for institutional implementation, research validation, and integration into hiring, governance, and AI systems design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fitrah验证协议(FVP)，一种基于人类官能的评估方法，用于在组织环境中识别具有真实能动性的人，以应对AI模拟人类带来的真实性挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何在组织环境中可靠地区分真实的人类能动性与AI模拟，并建立相应的验证协议？
AI.motivation: 当代组织面临前所未有的真实性挑战，AI系统能够模拟人类沟通、推理甚至道德话语，现有验证方法无法可靠区分真实人类能动性与AI模拟。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fitrah框架（八官能本体论）、基于证据的行为认知评估（信噪比测量原理）、制度权威宪法机制（IACM）
AI.method: Fitrah验证协议(FVP)，包含四个评估阶段：识别制度背景、呈现官能练习场景、评估价值选择一致性、评价制度适配性
AI.findings: 从基于特质转向基于真实性的招聘和治理的组织，在领导力发展、文化一致性、员工保留和卓越表现方面都有可测量的改善
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于官能的真实性评估理论框架，整合了人类官能本体论、信噪比测量原理和制度设计原则，为区分真实人类能动性与AI模拟提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实施的验证协议，可用于招聘、组织治理和AI系统设计，帮助组织应对外部（AI冒充人类）和内部（制度自动化侵蚀人类能力）的双重威胁

title:
Institutional Authority Constitutional Mechanics (IACM):
A Non-Psychological Framework for Diagnosing and Designing Authority Architectures
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Institutional Authority Constitutional Mechanics (IACM):
A Non-Psychological Framework for Diagnosing and Designing Authority Architectures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is theoretical and structural in nature. It does not report primary data collection involving human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data. Accordingly, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Modern institutions—from government agencies to corporations and AI systems—suffer recurring breakdowns that outlive leadership changes and culture initiatives. Yet most governance literature focuses on mindsets (culture) or individuals (bad actors), overlooking the underlying architecture of authority and decision-making. 

We present Institutional Authority Constitutional Mechanics (IACM), a framework that diagnoses and designs institutional governance as assemblies of authority domains rather than as psychological or cultural entities. IACM reframes the central governance question: not "Who is to blame?" but "How are decisions arranged?"

IACM explicitly abstracts away from individual psychology—intentionally deferring to the EightFaculty ontology and measurement frameworks of the Fitrah Framework (Paper 1) and Evidence- Based Behavioral-Cognitive Assessment (Paper 2)—to focus purely on structural decision-making arrangements. The eight authority domains exist precisely to protect institutional conditions where authentic human faculty expression becomes visible, measurable, and valued, as formalized in the Fitrah Verification Protocol (Paper 4). 

IACM identifies eight irreducible authority domains—Zeus (authorization), Hera (principles), Athena (oversight), Artemis (appeal), Hermes (information), Ares (execution), Nemesis (enforcement), and Hades (termination)—and specifies the minimal set of counter-links (checks and balances) needed to satisfy five stability invariants. 

The framework operationalizes structural pathology as a mismatch: when delegated authority persistently exceeds the system's built-in containment capacity (veto, appeal, shutdown authority). IACM is explicitly artifact-driven: institutions are diagnosed using charters, meeting records, audit logs, and policies—never by speculating about leader motives or culture. 

Historical case analysis demonstrates that institutional failures (NASA Shuttle program, Enron, FTX, Volkswagen emissions scandal) all exhibit missing domains or incomplete counter-links. We propose specific structural remedies: establish independent oversight boards, formalize shutdown authority, implement transparent information flows, create robust appeals mechanisms. 

IACM extends to AI governance by mapping domains to technical controls. Many AI failures simply mirror classical institutional flaws—missing oversight or appeal processes. The thesis is that stable governance requires: every power accompanied by a built-in check, every decision reversible through appeal, every process terminable by designated authority, and all actions traceable and reviewable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了制度权威宪法机制（IACM）框架，将制度治理视为权威领域的组合而非心理或文化实体。该框架识别了八个不可简化的权威领域，并通过结构病理学诊断制度失败，为传统机构和AI治理提供具体结构补救措施。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构性决策安排而非心理或文化因素来诊断和设计制度治理，以防止制度反复崩溃？
AI.motivation: 现代机构（从政府机构到企业和AI系统）反复出现超越领导层变动和文化倡议的崩溃。现有治理文献过度关注心态（文化）或个人（不良行为者），忽视了权威和决策的基本架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度权威宪法机制（IACM）框架，基于八个权威领域：Zeus（授权）、Hera（原则）、Athena（监督）、Artemis（上诉）、Hermes（信息）、Ares（执行）、Nemesis（执行）、Hades（终止）。该框架强调结构性决策安排而非心理学解释。
AI.method: 框架开发与历史案例分析。使用宪章、会议记录、审计日志和政策等人工制品诊断制度，避免推测领导动机或文化。通过NASA航天飞机计划、安然、FTX、大众排放丑闻等案例验证框架。
AI.findings: 制度失败都表现出缺失的权威领域或不完整的反制链接（制衡）。结构病理学表现为：当授权权威持续超过系统内置的遏制能力（否决、上诉、关闭权威）时发生不匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将治理问题从"谁该负责？"重新定义为"决策如何安排？"；2. 提出权威领域的结构化框架；3. 建立结构病理学诊断方法；4. 将AI治理映射到传统制度控制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 具体结构补救措施：建立独立监督委员会、正式化关闭权威、实施透明信息流、创建稳健上诉机制；2. 为AI治理提供技术控制映射；3. 提供基于人工制品的诊断工具。

title: Gap Based Learning in Markets
affiliations: and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Gap Based Learning in Markets
detail.abstract: We consider a broad class of learning algorithms, which we dub gap-based algorithms (GBAs). At a high level, GBA's quantify an algorithm's sensitivity-how quickly they penalize (prune) sub-optimal actions-and tolerance-the threshold level of sub-optimality separating which actions are explored frequently or pruned. As these natural conditions are satisfied by many popular learning algorithms such as Hedge and e t-greedy, GBAs are ubiquitous in both theory and practice. Our main contribution is a set of conditions on the agents' sensitivities and tolerances that guarantee that the corresponding GBA dynamics avoid convergence towards certain Nash equilibria (NE). In particular, let S n (p) denote agent n's set of substitutes-actions that are jointly optimal but unsupported at NE p. In order for the dynamics to converge to p, the sub-optimalities of any a e S n (p) must grow more quickly than agent n's tolerance, where these sub-optimalities can be expressed as a function of their opponents' sensitivities. Conversely, if this sub-optimality grows slowly, then the dynamics cannot converge to p. With this in mind, we give two sets of conditions-one on the algorithms' parameters and the second on the game itself-which guarantee non-convergence regardless of the initial behavior or history of the dynamics. Our results have interesting implications for equilibrium selection in various economic settings such as the first price and uniform price auctions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基于差距的算法"（GBAs）框架，分析学习算法的敏感性和容忍度特性，并给出避免收敛到特定纳什均衡的条件，对拍卖等经济场景的均衡选择有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 基于差距的学习算法（GBAs）在何种条件下会避免收敛到某些纳什均衡？
AI.motivation: 许多流行的学习算法（如Hedge和ε-greedy）在实践中广泛使用，但对其收敛行为缺乏统一的理论分析框架，特别是在避免收敛到次优均衡方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于差距的算法（GBAs）框架，包含敏感性（算法惩罚次优行动的速度）和容忍度（区分频繁探索与剪枝的次优性阈值）两个核心概念。
AI.method: 理论分析：通过分析代理的敏感性和容忍度特性，推导出避免收敛到特定纳什均衡的数学条件，包括算法参数条件和博弈本身的条件。
AI.findings: 1. 收敛到纳什均衡p需要代理n的替代行动S_n(p)的次优性增长速度快于代理n的容忍度；2. 如果次优性增长缓慢，则动态无法收敛到p；3. 给出了两组保证非收敛的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出GBAs统一框架分析学习算法；2. 建立敏感性和容忍度与均衡收敛的理论联系；3. 提供避免收敛到特定纳什均衡的充分条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拍卖等经济场景的均衡选择提供理论指导；2. 帮助设计避免收敛到不良均衡的学习算法；3. 对第一价格拍卖和统一价格拍卖有具体应用价值。

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种解决量化金融中深度强化学习面临的数据稀缺悖论的新方法，通过生成式AI进行数据增强，但避免了传统方法的套利幻觉问题。
AI.research_question: 如何解决量化金融中深度强化学习面临的数据稀缺悖论，即如何生成包含罕见但高影响的尾部事件的合成数据，同时避免传统生成式AI方法产生的套利幻觉？
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在量化金融中的应用受到"数据稀缺悖论"的根本性阻碍，即对历史记录中统计上代表性不足的罕见高影响尾部事件的严重依赖。虽然生成式AI通过数据增强提供了理论解决方案，但传统方法如GANs和VAEs经常遭受"套利幻觉"问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 数据稀缺悖论理论；2) 生成式AI在金融数据增强中的应用；3) 套利幻觉现象及其对量化策略的影响；4) 尾部事件建模理论
AI.method: 提出了一种新的生成式AI方法来解决传统GANs和VAEs的局限性，该方法能够生成包含真实尾部事件的合成金融数据，同时避免套利幻觉。
AI.findings: 论文发现传统生成式AI方法在金融数据增强中存在套利幻觉问题，即生成的合成数据可能包含不现实的套利机会，从而误导深度强化学习模型。提出的新方法能够更准确地模拟真实市场条件，包括尾部事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 形式化了量化金融中的数据稀缺悖论概念；2) 识别并分析了生成式AI中的套利幻觉问题；3) 提出了解决这一问题的理论框架；4) 扩展了生成式AI在金融领域的应用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为量化金融从业者提供了更可靠的深度强化学习训练数据生成方法；2) 提高了基于AI的交易策略在罕见市场事件中的稳健性；3) 减少了因合成数据质量问题导致的策略失效风险；4) 为金融机构采用生成式AI进行数据增强提供了实用指南

title: Manufacturing Management Practices in the Western Balkans
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business and Vienna University of Economics and Business - Department of Global Business and Trade

detail.title: Manufacturing Management Practices in the Western Balkans

declarations.funderStatement: Data collection was supported by Festo Fellowship-

detail.abstract: This project investigates the quality of management practices in manufacturing plants in the Western Balkans. In particular, we focus on modern operations, quality of monitoring, target setting, and incentive management skills applied within manufacturing plants. Our goal was to assess and benchmark the management practices in the Western Balkans region for which very limited information is available so far. We evaluate management practices by defining the concept of “god" and “bad" management practices on a scale from 1 to 5 across key management practices used by organizations across different manufacturing sectors. We do this by using an innovative and rich study design that includes a survey, qualitative interviews, and secondary data. We provide practically relevant findings for policymakers, managers of manufacturing companies, as well as for industrial education and consultancy firms, who can provide potential solutions to improve the effectiveness of management practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估西巴尔干地区制造工厂的管理实践质量，重点关注现代运营、监控质量、目标设定和激励管理，通过调查、访谈和二手数据提供1-5分评级，为政策制定者、企业管理者和咨询机构提供实用建议。
AI.research_question: 西巴尔干地区制造工厂的管理实践质量如何？特别是在现代运营、监控、目标设定和激励管理方面的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 西巴尔干地区制造业管理实践信息非常有限，需要评估和基准测试该地区的管理质量，为改进提供基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于管理实践评估框架，将管理实践概念化为"好"与"坏"的连续体，采用1-5分评级量表评估关键管理维度。
AI.method: 采用创新的混合研究方法：问卷调查、定性访谈和二手数据分析，跨不同制造部门评估管理实践。
AI.findings: 提供了西巴尔干地区制造工厂管理实践的详细评估结果，包括各维度的评分和基准比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 为管理实践评估理论提供了西巴尔干地区的实证证据，扩展了管理质量评估的地理覆盖范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、制造企业管理者和工业教育/咨询公司提供实用建议，帮助他们改进管理实践的有效性。

title: Selling Self-Disruptive Technologies: Identity-Compatible Advantage and the Role-Level Microfoundations of Automation Adoption
affiliations: Harvard Business School and Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: Selling Self-Disruptive Technologies: Identity-Compatible Advantage and the Role-Level Microfoundations of Automation Adoption

keywords: Selling and Deploying AI and automation solutions in B2B markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-050

detail.abstract:
Despite massive investment in artificial intelligence and automation, many high‑value technology projects stall after approval or are adopted only symbolically, especially in B2B markets where adoption depends on the endorsement of managers whose roles are disrupted by the technology. We argue that dominant adoption theories focused on firm‑level readiness, usefulness, and institutional pressure overlook a central marketing problem: selling and governing technologies that undermine the approving role itself.

We introduce Self‑Disruptive Technologies (SDTs), offerings that enhance organizational performance while eroding the authority, discretion, or span of control of the role responsible for approving them.  We develop Identity‑Compatible Advantage (ICA), a complementary bundle of seller‑designed solution and governance mechanisms that enables approvers to endorse automation without identity loss and shapes approval, implementation depth, and diffusion under identity threat. Integrating organizational buying, role identity, and innovation adoption theories, we advance propositions that shift attention from organizational resistance to role‑level threat, showing how bundled ICA mechanisms convert symbolic into substantive adoption and accelerate diffusion in B2B AI markets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自我颠覆技术"概念，指那些提升组织绩效但侵蚀审批者权力的技术。作者开发了"身份兼容优势"框架，通过解决方案和治理机制捆绑，帮助审批者在身份威胁下支持自动化技术，从而促进实质性采纳而非象征性采纳。
AI.research_question: 在B2B市场中，当技术会颠覆审批者自身角色时，如何促进这些"自我颠覆技术"的实质性采纳和扩散？
AI.motivation: 尽管人工智能和自动化投资巨大，但许多高价值技术项目在批准后停滞不前或仅被象征性采纳，特别是在B2B市场中，采纳取决于那些角色被技术颠覆的经理的认可。现有采纳理论忽视了这一核心营销问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合组织购买理论、角色身份理论和创新采纳理论，提出自我颠覆技术和身份兼容优势框架，将关注点从组织层面抵抗转向角色层面威胁。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，基于现有理论整合提出新概念框架和命题，未明确说明实证方法。
AI.findings: 提出身份兼容优势框架，通过捆绑解决方案和治理机制，使审批者能够在身份威胁下支持自动化技术，将象征性采纳转化为实质性采纳，并加速B2B AI市场的扩散。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 引入自我颠覆技术概念；2) 开发身份兼容优势框架；3) 将采纳理论焦点从组织层面转向角色层面；4) 整合组织购买、角色身份和创新采纳理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术销售商提供具体策略：设计捆绑的解决方案和治理机制，帮助审批者在不损失身份的情况下支持颠覆性技术，从而提高采纳深度和扩散速度。

title: Research on the Input-Output Efficiency Model of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) in Financial Supply Chains
affiliations: , Independent, Independent, Cornell University, ,  and University of Michigan

detail.title: Research on the Input-Output Efficiency Model of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) in Financial Supply Chains
detail.abstract: This study focuses on the input-output efficiency of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) in financial supply chains, aiming to address the efficiency evaluation dilemma caused by the multi-factor input and multi-objective output characteristics of RPA application. Based on the theory of data envelopment analysis (DEA), the study constructs a three-stage DEA efficiency evaluation model that incorporates environmental variables and stochastic errors. It selects core indicators such as RPA deployment cost, technical maintenance input, transaction processing speed, and capital turnover rate from the dimensions of resource input and benefit output. Empirical analysis is conducted on 32 financial supply chain enterprises. The results show that the model effectively eliminates the interference of external environmental factors, and the evaluation results are more consistent with the actual operation status of enterprises. Moreover, the rational allocation of technical maintenance resources significantly improves the input-output efficiency of RPA. This research provides a scientific evaluation tool for enterprises to optimize RPA application strategies and enhances the operational efficiency of financial supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个三阶段DEA模型来评估金融供应链中RPA的投入产出效率，通过消除环境变量和随机误差的干扰，为优化RPA应用策略提供了科学工具。
AI.research_question: 如何科学评估金融供应链中机器人流程自动化（RPA）的投入产出效率，解决其多因素投入、多目标输出带来的评估困境？
AI.motivation: RPA在金融供应链中的应用具有多因素投入和多目标输出的特点，导致效率评估面临困境，需要构建科学的评估模型来准确衡量其实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据包络分析（DEA）理论，构建包含环境变量和随机误差的三阶段DEA效率评估模型。
AI.method: 从资源投入和效益产出维度选取RPA部署成本、技术维护投入、交易处理速度、资金周转率等核心指标，对32家金融供应链企业进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 模型有效消除了外部环境因素的干扰，评估结果更符合企业实际运营状况；技术维护资源的合理配置显著提升RPA的投入产出效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了DEA理论在RPA效率评估中的应用，构建了适用于多因素投入、多目标输出的三阶段评估模型，为相关研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业优化RPA应用策略提供了科学评估工具，有助于提升金融供应链的运营效率，特别是技术维护资源的合理配置建议具有重要实践价值。

title: Hybrid VARIMA-Machine Learning Models for Multivariate Macroeconomic and Energy Forecasting
affiliations: ,  and Independent

detail.title: Hybrid VARIMA-Machine Learning Models for Multivariate Macroeconomic and Energy Forecasting
detail.abstract: Accurate forecasting of macroeconomic and energy time series is complicated by structural instability, strong cross-dependencies, and pervasive nonlinear dynamics. While VARIMA models provide a transparent multivariate framework for linear shock propagation, they often leave economically meaningful structure in forecast residuals. Conversely, machine learning methods offer flexibility but may suffer from instability and limited interpretability in multivariate economic environments. This paper proposes a residual-based hybrid forecasting framework that integrates VARIMA and machine learning in a disciplined and interpretable manner. VARIMA serves as a linear filter capturing common dynamics across macroeconomic, financial, and energy variables, while machine learning models estimate nonlinear corrections from multivariate residuals. Using monthly data from 1999 to 2025, including multiple crisis episodes, we document systematic violations of linear model assumptions through extensive diagnostics. Out-of-sample results show that hybrid models consistently outperform both standalone VARIMA and pure machine learning approaches in terms of accuracy and robustness, particularly during periods of stress. The findings highlight residual-based hybridization as an effective and economically interpretable strategy for multivariate forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于残差的混合预测框架，将VARIMA模型与机器学习方法结合，用于宏观经济和能源时间序列的预测。该方法利用VARIMA捕捉线性动态，用机器学习处理非线性残差，在准确性和稳健性上优于单一方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既准确又具有经济解释性的混合预测框架，以应对宏观经济和能源时间序列中的结构不稳定性、强交叉依赖性和非线性动态？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济和能源时间序列预测面临结构不稳定性、强交叉依赖性和普遍非线性动态的挑战。VARIMA模型虽然提供透明的多变量线性框架，但常留下经济上有意义的残差结构；而机器学习方法虽然灵活，但在多变量经济环境中可能存在不稳定性和解释性有限的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于残差的混合预测理论框架，结合时间序列分析中的VARIMA模型和机器学习方法。VARIMA作为线性滤波器捕捉宏观经济、金融和能源变量间的共同动态，机器学习模型则从多变量残差中估计非线性修正。
AI.method: 使用1999年至2025年的月度数据，包含多个危机时期。首先通过广泛的诊断测试记录线性模型假设的系统性违反，然后构建混合预测框架：VARIMA捕捉线性动态，机器学习处理残差中的非线性模式。进行样本外预测性能评估。
AI.findings: 混合模型在准确性和稳健性方面一致优于单独的VARIMA和纯机器学习方法，特别是在压力时期表现更佳。广泛的诊断测试揭示了线性模型假设的系统性违反。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于残差的混合预测理论框架，为多变量时间序列预测提供了一种既保持经济解释性又能捕捉非线性动态的方法论。该框架在理论上整合了传统计量经济学方法和现代机器学习技术的优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济和能源预测实践提供了一种有效的混合预测策略，特别是在危机时期能够提供更准确和稳健的预测结果。该方法具有经济解释性，便于政策制定者和分析师理解和应用。

title: Energy Efficiency and Sustainability in 5G Network Deployments
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Energy Efficiency and Sustainability in 5G Network Deployments
detail.abstract: Concerns about the energy and environmental impact of the world's rapid implementation of fifth-generation (5G) mobile networks are growing. Achieving ultra-high data rates, low latency, and massive connectivity requires the construction of extremely dense network architectures, and small cell networks, as well as massive multiple-input (MIMO) technologies, and edge computing. These technologies increase energy consumption and carbon footprints on a global scale (Chochliouros et al.; Williams et al.). This study focuses on the 5G energy and sustainability challenges. This study uses a systematic literature synthesis and a comparative study of the state of the art in energy-efficient literature and applicable frameworks for sustainability to evaluate existing solutions and identify prevailing gaps (Maiwada et al.; Usama and Erol-Kantarci). Based on the results, the authors identify the most significant negative consequences of sub-optimal network performance to cover larger gaps in energy consumption and explain the result of most network buildouts: cardinally optimized energy cost expansion resulting from a disproportionate increase in network capacity. The potential of recent advances such as artificial intelligence (AI) network optimization, traffic-aware resource management, and high-quality service (QoS) integration of renewable energy to resolve these challenges is underscored (Israr et al.; Mughees et al.). The study outlines the need for a comprehensive, multi-dimensional, and holistic approach towards the designing of sustainable 5G networks, adopting an energy-aware network framework and intelligent control machinery, alongside the introduction of corresponding policies and regulations to address the technological and ecological impacts of rapid advancement (Ichimescu et al.; Lorincz et al.).

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了5G网络快速发展带来的能源和环境挑战，通过文献综述和比较研究评估现有解决方案，指出网络容量不成比例增长导致的能源成本扩张问题，并强调AI优化、流量感知资源管理和可再生能源整合等先进技术的潜力，呼吁采用多维度的可持续5G网络设计方法。
AI.research_question: 如何解决5G网络快速发展带来的能源消耗和环境影响挑战？现有解决方案的有效性如何？存在哪些研究空白？
AI.motivation: 5G网络的快速部署（包括超密集网络架构、小基站网络、大规模MIMO技术和边缘计算）显著增加了全球能源消耗和碳足迹，引发了对能源和环境可持续性的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源效率文献和可持续性框架的系统性分析框架，结合网络性能优化理论、资源管理理论和可持续设计原则。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述和比较研究方法，分析现有能源效率文献和适用可持续性框架，评估现有解决方案并识别研究空白。
AI.findings: 1. 网络容量不成比例增长导致能源成本扩张；2. 次优网络性能对能源消耗产生显著负面影响；3. AI网络优化、流量感知资源管理和可再生能源整合具有解决这些挑战的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了5G能源可持续性挑战的理论框架；2. 识别了网络容量扩张与能源成本关系的理论机制；3. 提出了多维度的可持续5G网络设计理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为网络运营商提供能源优化策略；2. 为政策制定者提供监管框架建议；3. 为技术开发者指明AI优化和可再生能源整合的技术方向；4. 倡导采用能源感知网络框架和智能控制机制。

title: Paying for Good Behavior: What is the Optimal Incentive Structure?
affiliations: Purdue University - College of Agriculture

detail.title: Paying for Good Behavior: What is the Optimal Incentive Structure?
detail.abstract: When policy makers want individuals to adopt behaviors that are individually or socially beneficial (e.g. smoking cessation, healthy eating, healthy activities, etc), one option is to offer monetary incentives. The payoff function for the policy maker in this class of problems may have the ``common values'' property from the principal-agent literature, where the principal benefits when some types of agents perform but not others.  For example, in the realm of healthy eating, the principal may derive more value from unhealthy people improving their diets than people who are already healthy.  When the agent type is unknown  to the principal, Laffont and Martimort (2002) find that pooling incentive schemes can be optimal under a very stringent assumption on the principal's benefit function, which causes the monotonicity condition to be violated.  I show that this assumption can be relaxed and pooling incentives are still optimal, suggesting that the optimality of pooling incentives is fairly robust.  An implication of this finding is that monetary incentives for good behavior can be fairly simple, with no need to structure complex screening menus that try to induce agents to self-select into customized incentive plans.

AI.tldr: 本文研究政策制定者如何设计货币激励措施来促进有益行为（如戒烟、健康饮食等）。研究发现，在某些情况下，简单的"混合"激励方案（对所有参与者提供相同激励）比复杂的"筛选"方案更优，这挑战了传统委托代理理论中需要定制化激励的假设。
AI.research_question: 在政策制定者希望促进有益行为（如健康饮食）但无法了解个体类型的情况下，何时应该采用简单的混合激励方案而非复杂的筛选方案？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者经常使用货币激励来促进有益行为，但传统委托代理理论建议设计复杂的筛选菜单让代理人自我选择。然而，实际中政策制定者往往采用简单统一的激励方案。本文旨在解释这种简单方案在理论上的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Laffont和Martimort（2002）的委托代理理论框架，特别是具有"共同价值"属性的支付函数，其中委托人的收益取决于代理人类型（如健康人vs不健康人）。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过放松Laffont和Martimort（2002）的严格假设，分析混合激励方案的最优性条件。
AI.findings: 混合激励方案的最优性比Laffont和Martimort（2002）所认为的更稳健。即使放松他们的严格假设，混合激励仍然可能是最优的。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了委托代理理论，表明混合激励方案的最优性条件比先前认为的更宽松，为简单激励方案提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理论支持，表明在促进有益行为时，简单的货币激励方案（如统一奖励）可能比复杂的定制化方案更优，降低了实施成本和管理复杂性。

title: Not in My Backyard, But in My City:Experimental Evidence on What Motivates Citizens to Co-design
affiliations: Incheon National University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Not in My Backyard, But in My City:Experimental Evidence on What Motivates Citizens to Co-design
detail.abstract: Much of the NIMBY literature explains why residents oppose controversial facilities and often treats self-interest as a core driver of local resistance. We shift the focus from opposition to engagement by examining citizens’ willingness to co-design in contested siting contexts. Drawing on a vignette experiment in urban South Korea centered on a proposed mental health rehabilitation facility, we test whether motivational framing shapes willingness to co-design, comparing a proximity-based self-interest frame (“in front of my home”) with a broader community-interest frame (“in my city”), and we assess the role of participation self-efficacy. Results show that the self-interest frame increases willingness to co-design relative to the community-interest frame. Participation self-efficacy also strongly predicts both willingness to co-design and willingness to receive additional information about local public hearings. Public service motivation is positively associated with willingness to co-design but does not condition framing effects. Open-ended responses underscore that perceived capability and procedural confidence frequently determine whether residents engage, often more than civic-minded appeals. Overall, the findings suggest that co-design under local conflict depends not only on aligning interests, but also on strengthening residents’ capacity to participate. We argue that cities aiming to make co-design workable in contentious settings should invest early in efficacy-building interventions, including clear role expectations, accessible participation routes, and low-stakes entry points that allow residents to contribute and see tangible influence on decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过韩国城市中的实验发现，在争议设施选址情境下，基于自利框架（"在我家门前"）比社区利益框架（"在我所在城市"）更能提高居民共同设计的意愿。参与自我效能是影响参与意愿的关键因素，而公共服务动机虽与参与意愿正相关但不调节框架效应。
AI.research_question: 在争议设施选址情境下，动机框架（自利框架 vs 社区利益框架）如何影响居民共同设计的意愿？参与自我效能和公共服务动机在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有NIMBY文献主要关注居民反对争议设施的原因，并将自利视为核心驱动力。本研究转向关注居民在争议选址情境下的参与意愿，探讨如何通过框架设计促进共同设计，而非仅仅解释反对行为。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. NIMBY（邻避）理论：传统上关注居民反对争议设施的自利动机
2. 框架理论：不同动机框架（自利vs社区利益）对行为意愿的影响
3. 自我效能理论：个体对自己参与能力的信念对行为的影响
4. 公共服务动机理论：个体为公共利益服务的动机
AI.method: 采用小插曲实验法，在韩国城市环境中进行。以拟建的心理健康康复设施为背景，比较两种动机框架：基于邻近性的自利框架（"在我家门前"）和更广泛的社区利益框架（"在我所在城市"）。测量参与自我效能、公共服务动机、共同设计意愿和获取听证会信息的意愿。结合定量分析和开放式回答的定性分析。
AI.findings:
1. 自利框架比社区利益框架更能提高居民共同设计的意愿
2. 参与自我效能强烈预测共同设计意愿和获取听证会信息的意愿
3. 公共服务动机与共同设计意愿正相关，但不调节框架效应
4. 开放式回答显示，感知能力和程序信心比公民意识诉求更能决定居民是否参与
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将NIMBY研究焦点从反对转向参与，拓展了理论视角
2. 揭示了在争议情境下，自利框架反而能促进参与，挑战了传统假设
3. 强调了参与自我效能的关键作用，为理解参与行为提供了新维度
4. 提出了在冲突情境下共同设计不仅需要利益协调，更需要能力建设的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为城市管理者提供了促进争议设施共同设计的实用策略：使用自利框架而非社区利益框架
2. 建议早期投资于效能建设干预措施，包括明确的角色期望、可及的参与途径和低风险的切入点
3. 强调让居民看到对决策的有形影响力对于促进参与的重要性
4. 为在争议环境中实施可行的共同设计提供了具体操作指南

title: Crossing the Threshold: Employment Regulation, Firm Behaviour and Labour Market Flexibility in Italy
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Crossing the Threshold: Employment Regulation, Firm Behaviour and Labour Market Flexibility in Italy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 983
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how employment protection legislation and firing costs affect firm size growth and workforce composition in Italy (as a ratio of temporary to permanent employment), with a particular focus on recent labour market reforms. The analysis is based on administrative firm-level data from the Italian private sector, with a specific focus on firm outcomes above the 15-employee threshold, where stricter employment regulations apply. Using a linear probability model, we find that firms near this threshold are less likely to grow in terms of employee numbers. Furthermore, the discontinuity in employment protection influences the composition of the workforce, leading to a higher incidence of temporary contracts above the threshold. We apply a difference-in-discontinuities approach to examine the heterogeneity in the threshold effect during a period of labour market reforms. Our results suggest that recent reforms have had negligible effects on the discontinuity in firms’ employment growth. As for the use of flexible contracts, we observe a mitigation of the threshold effect after the regulatory changes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究意大利就业保护立法和解雇成本如何影响企业规模增长和劳动力构成（临时工与正式工比例），特别关注近期劳动力市场改革。研究发现15人门槛导致企业不愿扩大规模，且门槛以上临时工比例更高，近期改革对就业增长门槛效应影响有限，但对灵活合同使用有缓解作用。
AI.research_question: 就业保护立法和解雇成本如何影响意大利企业的规模增长和劳动力构成（临时工与正式工比例）？近期劳动力市场改革如何改变这些影响？
AI.motivation: 意大利劳动力市场存在严格的就业保护法规，特别是15人以上企业面临更严格监管，这可能影响企业扩张决策和雇佣策略。近期改革旨在增加劳动力市场灵活性，需要评估这些政策变化的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 就业保护立法理论、解雇成本理论、企业规模决策理论、劳动力市场分割理论、制度经济学框架
AI.method: 使用意大利私营部门企业层面行政数据，聚焦15人门槛以上企业；采用线性概率模型分析企业增长概率；应用差异-间断方法评估改革期间门槛效应的异质性
AI.findings: 1) 接近15人门槛的企业扩大员工规模的可能性较低；2) 就业保护的不连续性影响劳动力构成，门槛以上临时合同比例更高；3) 近期改革对企业就业增长的门槛效应影响有限；4) 监管变化后灵活合同使用的门槛效应有所缓解
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对就业保护立法如何通过监管门槛影响企业行为的理解；为劳动力市场分割理论提供实证支持；扩展了制度约束下企业决策的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于就业保护法规实际影响的证据；帮助理解劳动力市场改革的效果；为企业人力资源管理提供参考；对监管门槛设计有政策启示

title: Deep Learning Driven Metaheuristic for Enhancing Vehicle Routing Solutions
affiliations: Athens University of Economics and Business, Athens University of Economics and Business and Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of Management Science and Technology

detail.title: Deep Learning Driven Metaheuristic for Enhancing Vehicle Routing Solutions
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the integration of machine learning techniques with classical optimization methodologies to address the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a well-known NP-hard problem in logistics. Traditional approaches leverage heuristics and metaheuristics, such as GRASP and VND, but often struggle with adaptability and efficiency at large scale. Recent advancements in deep learning offer new opportunities for enhanced solution quality and computational efficiency. This study proposes a novel hybrid methodology combining Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure (GRASP), Variable Neighborhood Descent (VND), and a Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge Features (GINE). The GINE model classifies initial solutions as promising or unpromising, enabling selective local search refinement and potential computational savings. Empirical evaluation on benchmark CVRP instances demonstrates that the hybrid GINE-GRASP-VND approach achieves moderate classification accuracy, generalizes beyond training sizes, and shows stronger improvements on large problems. Results suggest the value of machine learning augmentation in metaheuristics but highlight the challenges of feature design and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合图同构网络(GINE)、贪婪随机自适应搜索(GRASP)和变邻域下降(VND)的混合方法，用于解决带容量约束的车辆路径问题(CVRP)。GINE用于分类初始解的质量，引导局部搜索，在基准测试中表现出中等分类准确率，并能泛化到不同规模的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将机器学习技术（特别是图神经网络）与经典优化方法结合，以提高解决大规模带容量约束车辆路径问题(CVRP)的效率和适应性？
AI.motivation: 传统启发式和元启发式方法（如GRASP和VND）在处理大规模CVRP问题时面临适应性和效率挑战，而深度学习技术为提升解的质量和计算效率提供了新的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合元启发式优化理论（GRASP、VND）和图神经网络理论（GINE），形成混合优化框架，利用机器学习增强传统优化方法的性能。
AI.method: 提出GINE-GRASP-VND混合方法：1) GINE图神经网络对初始解进行分类（有希望/无希望）；2) 基于分类结果选择性应用局部搜索；3) 在基准CVRP实例上进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 混合方法达到中等分类准确率，能够泛化到训练集以外的规模，在大规模问题上表现出更强的改进效果，证明了机器学习增强元启发式的价值，但也凸显了特征设计和泛化的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将图神经网络与经典元启发式优化方法结合的混合框架理论，为机器学习增强优化算法提供了新的理论视角和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的GINE-GRASP-VND混合算法，能够更有效地解决大规模CVRP问题，为物流和供应链管理中的车辆路径优化提供了新的工具。

title: Analytics for Better Urban Cycling at the City of Toronto
affiliations: University of Toronto, University of Toronto - Department of Civil & Mineral Engineering, University of Toronto and University of Toronto, Mechanical and Industrial Engineering Department

detail.title: Analytics for Better Urban Cycling at the City of Toronto
detail.abstract: Cycling is an effective way to promote healthy lifestyles, improve urban mobility, and combat climate change. However, safety and comfort concerns remain major barriers to cycling uptake globally. To make cycling safer and more inviting, we collaborated with the City of Toronto to develop and implement a suite of analytics tools for urban bike infrastructure planning. First, we propose a descriptive analytics framework that assesses cycling stress-the discomfort cyclists experience-on each road segment and quantifies the network's low-stress cycling accessibility. This framework has been used to evaluate over ten bike infrastructure projects in Toronto and to estimate the infrastructure budget required to meet the city's net-zero target. Building on this framework, we develop an optimization model that identifies optimal locations for new bike lanes. This model is a large-scale bilevel program that cannot be solved with existing techniques. In response, we develop a machine learning-augmented optimization method that is computationally tractable and can generate provably high-quality solutions. From 2022 to 2024, this approach would have matched the performance of Toronto's implemented plan while reducing the required lane length by 25%, saving an estimated 18 million Canadian dollars. As of March 2025, 29.1 km of bike lanes recommended by our model had been approved by Toronto City Council for construction between 2025 and 2027, with an additional 27.6 km under study for future implementation. Finally, we introduce a predictive model and a web application to support broader application of our methods. The predictive model assesses cycling stress based on street-view images, enabling deployment in cities lacking detailed road network data. The web application enables interactive refinement of optimization results, allowing practitioners to engage seamlessly with our tools. As urban centers increasingly prioritize sustainable transportation, this work offers a scalable and user-friendly framework for leveraging analytics to guide impactful infrastructure decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一套用于城市自行车基础设施规划的智能分析工具，包括骑行压力评估框架、优化选址模型、预测模型和Web应用，已在多伦多成功应用并节省了1800万加元成本。

detail.title: Competitive Advantage of Asset Management and Brokerage Companies
detail.abstract: This article is devoted to the competitive advantages within asset management and brokerage services markets. Strategic management decisions play a crucial role in the operations of modern asset management and brokerage companies. They involve formulating long-term strategies in a competitive market environment to achieve optimal resource allocation and enhance competitive advantage. Effective strategic decision-making allows enterprises to adjust their operational direction, respond to market changes and maintain sustained competitiveness in a dynamic business environment. Therefore, how to make scientifically sound and reasonable strategic decisions in a complex and ever-changing market has become a major challenge for for CEO and COO of asset management and brokerage firms. Competitive asset managers separate themselves from less effective peers by making three changes to their distribution strategies, reflecting the influence of more powerful and industrial distributors. Nowadays the key mistake that many investors make is to assume that competitive advantage doesn't change much throughout the holding period of an investment. By focusing on seeking challenging and competitive stories, investors should identify companies that are not just successful today, but are poised to become even more successful in the future. This dynamic approach, combined with a rigorous understanding of industry nuances, allows them to uncover investment opportunities that traditional static analysis might miss. Investors actively assess how a company's competitive advantages are evolving. This involves a deep dive into various factors: is the company investing in ways that strengthen its market position? Can the company navigate technological disruption, regulatory changes and evolving consumer preferences?
