AI.motivation: 现有VAR模型通常使用完全正交化（Sims, 1980）或完全不正交化（Koop等, 1996; Pesaran和Shin, 1998）来识别网络连接性，这些都是更一般框架的特殊和极端情况，需要开发更灵活的方法来测量集群化网络连接性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于向量自回归（VAR）的方差分解方法测量网络连接性，结合Sims的正交化识别和Koop-Pesaran-Potter-Shin的广义识别，发展集群化连接性框架。
AI.method: 开发理论框架：允许网络节点按集群组织，冲击在集群间正交但在集群内相关。然后应用于实证分析：研究16个国家股票市场跨越3个全球区域的网络连接性。
AI.findings: 通过实证分析展示了集群化连接性框架在测量跨区域股票市场网络连接性方面的应用价值，提供了更灵活的网络连接性测量方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了更一般的网络连接性测量框架，统一了正交化和非正交化识别方法；2. 提出了集群化网络连接性概念，允许节点按集群组织；3. 扩展了Diebold和Yilmaz（2014）的网络连接性测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为经济网络分析提供了更灵活的工具；2. 可应用于资产类别、行业、地区等集群化网络分析；3. 实证展示了在跨国股票市场网络连接性研究中的应用。

title: Revising the Use of F-Tests in Weak Instrument Practice: Point Estimation and Beyond
affiliations: , University of Cambridge - MRC Biostatistics Unit and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Revising the Use of F-Tests in Weak Instrument Practice: Point Estimation and Beyond
detail.abstract: To analyse the performance of estimators under weak instruments, we adopt the local-tozero weak instrument asymptotics studied in Staiger and Stock (1997) and Stock and Yogo (2005). The commonly used F > 10 rule-of-thumb criterion is motivated by the relative bias, a metric comparing the performance of the OLS and 2SLS estimators. This metric fails to account for the variance of the 2SLS estimator when comparing its performance to that of the OLS estimator and hence assumes that 2SLS is always superior to OLS in performance, even when there is no confounding present, since the bias of 2SLS is always smaller than OLS. We show that, as a result, significant problems due to weak instruments can still persist even if the F > 10 rule-of-thumb is satisfied. To remedy this, we propose different metrics for comparing the performance of 2SLS with that of OLS and propose alternative criteria based on these alternative metrics as more targeted measures of instrument strength. A key challenge with these new metrics is that, unlike the relative bias, they depend on the amount of confounding present between the endogenous variable and outcome. We also make supplementary contributions such as rigorously proving that the relative bias in Stock and Yogo (2005) is monotonically decreasing in the concentration parameter for any fixed K ≥ 3.

AI.tldr: 本文分析弱工具变量下估计量的表现，指出传统F>10经验法则的局限性，并提出新的性能比较指标和替代标准。
AI.research_question: 在弱工具变量情况下，如何更准确地评估2SLS估计量相对于OLS估计量的性能？传统F>10经验法则存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 传统F>10经验法则基于相对偏差指标，但该指标忽略了2SLS估计量的方差，且假设2SLS总是优于OLS，即使在不存在混淆的情况下也是如此。这导致即使满足F>10标准，弱工具变量问题仍然可能存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Staiger和Stock（1997）以及Stock和Yogo（2005）提出的局部趋近于零的弱工具变量渐近理论框架。
AI.method: 采用弱工具变量渐近分析，比较OLS和2SLS估计量的性能，提出新的性能比较指标，并证明相对偏差与浓度参数的单调关系。
AI.findings: 1. 传统F>10经验法则存在缺陷，因为它忽略了2SLS的方差；2. 即使满足F>10标准，弱工具变量问题仍可能持续存在；3. 新的性能比较指标依赖于内生变量与结果之间的混淆程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出新的2SLS与OLS性能比较指标；2. 基于新指标提出替代的弱工具变量强度衡量标准；3. 严格证明Stock和Yogo（2005）中的相对偏差在固定K≥3时随浓度参数单调递减。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供更准确的工具变量强度评估标准，避免因依赖传统F>10经验法则而导致的错误推断。

title: Contract Design and Insurance Demand

detail.title: Contract Design and Insurance Demand
detail.abstract:
We introduce experimental variation in the insurance contracts offered to rice farmers in China to study how contract design affects insurance takeup. We compare a single-contract offering with menus that include multiple contracts differing in premiums and payouts. Expanding the contract menu substantially increases take-up, primarily through higher adoption of the basic, lowest-cost contract. Additional experimental variation in relative prices and information provision shows that these effects are driven by context effects arising from relative price comparisons within the menu, rather than information inference. The findings highlight contract menu design as an effective supply-side tool for expanding insurance coverage.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过实验研究中国稻农保险合约设计对参保率的影响，发现提供多合约菜单能显著提高参保率，主要是通过相对价格比较的上下文效应而非信息推断。
AI.research_question: 保险合约设计如何影响农民的保险参保率？特别是，提供多合约菜单相比单一合约是否能提高参保率？
AI.motivation: 理解如何通过保险合约设计来提高农业保险的参保率，这对于扩大保险覆盖范围、帮助农民管理风险具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的上下文效应和相对价格比较理论，以及保险需求理论。
AI.method: 在中国稻农中进行随机对照实验，引入保险合约设计的实验变异，比较单一合约与多合约菜单的效果，并操纵相对价格和信息提供。
AI.findings: 1. 扩大合约菜单显著提高参保率；2. 参保率提高主要源于基本、最低成本合约的采纳增加；3. 效果由菜单内相对价格比较产生的上下文效应驱动，而非信息推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为上下文效应和相对价格比较在保险决策中的作用提供实证证据；2. 揭示合约菜单设计作为行为干预机制的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为保险公司和政策制定者提供有效的供给侧工具来扩大保险覆盖；2. 建议通过设计多合约菜单来提高参保率；3. 强调相对价格比较而非信息提供的重要性。

title: Indebted Supply and Monetary Policy: A Theory of Financial Dominance
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Sciences Po and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Indebted Supply and Monetary Policy: A Theory of Financial Dominance
detail.abstract:
We develop a New Keynesian model with financial frictions to study how corporate capital structure shapes static and dynamic monetary policy tradeoffs through the supply side. Ex post, when corporate leverage is high, monetary tightening contracts both demand and supply. As a result, the Phillips curve is highly non-linear and state-dependent, and the “natural rate” Rn ensuring price stability increases with corporate leverage. Yet the tradeoff between inflation targeting and tightening supply constraints implies that the optimal ex-post policy is to set a rate Ropt < Rn that can decrease with leverage. Ex ante, firms’ market-timing incentives lead them to increase leverage when rates are low, which creates an intertemporal tradeoff: monetary easing supports current demand but hurts future supply, which makes easing partially self-defeating. The optimal ex-ante monetary policy features a prudential motive for leaning against leverage even when the divine coincidence holds in the current period.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含金融摩擦的新凯恩斯主义模型，研究企业资本结构如何通过供给侧影响货币政策的静态和动态权衡。研究发现：高杠杆时，货币紧缩会同时收缩需求和供给，导致菲利普斯曲线高度非线性和状态依赖；最优货币政策需要考虑通胀目标与供给侧约束的权衡；低利率会激励企业增加杠杆，形成跨期权衡——货币宽松支持当前需求但损害未来供给。
AI.research_question: 企业资本结构如何通过供给侧渠道影响货币政策的静态和动态权衡？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策分析主要关注需求侧效应，但现实中企业资本结构（特别是杠杆率）会影响供给侧对货币政策的反应。理解这种供给侧渠道对于制定有效的货币政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义模型（New Keynesian model）结合金融摩擦理论，分析企业资本结构对货币政策传导机制的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含金融摩擦和资本结构的新凯恩斯主义动态随机一般均衡模型，分析货币政策在不同杠杆状态下的效应。
AI.findings: 1. 高杠杆时，货币紧缩同时收缩需求和供给，菲利普斯曲线高度非线性和状态依赖；2. 确保价格稳定的"自然利率"随企业杠杆增加而上升；3. 最优事后政策利率低于自然利率，且可能随杠杆下降；4. 低利率激励企业增加杠杆，形成跨期权衡；5. 最优事前货币政策包含审慎动机，即使当前存在"神圣巧合"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将企业资本结构纳入货币政策分析框架；2. 揭示了货币政策通过供给侧渠道的传导机制；3. 提出了包含金融摩擦的货币政策动态权衡理论；4. 扩展了新凯恩斯主义模型在金融稳定性方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定货币政策时考虑企业杠杆因素提供理论依据；2. 解释了为什么在高杠杆环境下货币政策效果可能减弱；3. 为宏观审慎政策与货币政策的协调配合提供指导；4. 帮助政策制定者理解低利率环境可能带来的长期风险。

title: The Effect of Exposure: Evidence from Spatial Choices in Nairobi
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, Harvard University and The World Bank

detail.title: The Effect of Exposure: Evidence from Spatial Choices in Nairobi
detail.abstract:
How much do people dislike opportunities they have never been exposed to, and why? We study how exposure affects work location decisions of casual workers. We offer short-term employment and randomize training locations to induce novel exposures. Participants sacrifice 22% of the median daily wage to avoid working in a location never visited before; one hour-long visit eliminates this premium. Workers anticipate two thirds of the effect exposure has on their later preferences. Results are most consistent with perceived fixed costs of exposure rather than sorting or quality uncertainty. Unfamiliar neighborhoods are also less likely to enter workers' consideration sets.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，临时工人愿意牺牲22%的日薪来避免在从未去过的工作地点工作，但只需一小时的访问就能消除这种溢价。工人能预见到暴露对其偏好的三分之二影响。
AI.research_question: 人们对从未接触过的机会有多不喜欢？为什么？暴露如何影响临时工人的工作地点决策？
AI.motivation: 理解人们如何评估和避免从未接触过的机会，以及暴露如何影响决策，这对劳动力市场、消费者行为和政策设计具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 暴露效应、感知固定成本、考虑集理论、不确定性厌恶、信息不对称
AI.method: 随机对照实验：提供短期就业机会，随机分配培训地点以诱导新的暴露，测量工人对不同地点的工资要求差异
AI.findings: 1. 工人愿意牺牲22%的日薪来避免从未去过的工作地点；2. 只需一小时的访问就能消除这种溢价；3. 工人能预见到暴露对其偏好的三分之二影响；4. 结果最符合感知固定成本理论，而非排序或质量不确定性；5. 不熟悉的社区不太可能进入工人的考虑集
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了从未接触机会的厌恶程度；2. 揭示了暴露对偏好的影响机制；3. 支持感知固定成本而非其他解释；4. 扩展了考虑集理论在劳动力市场的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为雇主提供降低招聘成本的方法；2. 为政策制定者设计劳动力市场干预提供依据；3. 帮助理解地理流动性障碍；4. 为减少信息不对称提供实证支持

title: Class Mobility in the Era of Rising Inequality: A Synthetic Dynasty Analysis
affiliations: University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility, University of Chicago, University of Chicago and University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility

detail.title: Class Mobility in the Era of Rising Inequality: A Synthetic Dynasty Analysis
detail.abstract:
This paper studies contemporary trends in class mobility using a new approach based on the “synthetic dynasties” represented in Markov chains. This approach yields several novel measures of movement and memory, which respectively capture how class positions differ from one generation to the next and how the influence of class origins dissipates across generations. Applying these methods to data from the U.S., we find that overall levels of movement and memory have remained largely stable across cohorts born between 1945 and 1990. This stability, however, masks offsetting class-specific trends. Among those from the upper and lower classes, movement has declined and memory has increased. In contrast, among the middle classes, movement has risen and memory has weakened.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用"合成王朝"马尔可夫链方法分析美国1945-1990年出生队列的阶级流动性趋势，发现整体流动性稳定但存在阶级分化：上下阶级流动性下降、代际影响增强，而中产阶级流动性上升、代际影响减弱。
AI.research_question: 当代阶级流动性趋势如何？不同社会阶级的代际流动性和"记忆"（阶级起源影响）有何变化模式？
AI.motivation: 需要新的方法论来更精确地测量代际阶级流动性和阶级起源影响的持久性，以理解社会流动性的当代变化模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于马尔可夫链的"合成王朝"方法，引入"移动性"和"记忆性"两个核心概念，分别衡量代际阶级位置变化和阶级起源影响的衰减过程。
AI.method: 使用"合成王朝"马尔可夫链方法分析美国数据，研究1945-1990年出生队列的阶级流动性趋势。
AI.findings: 整体流动性和记忆性在1945-1990年出生队列中保持稳定，但存在阶级分化趋势：上下阶级流动性下降、记忆性增强；中产阶级流动性上升、记忆性减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于马尔可夫链的"合成王朝"新方法，发展了"移动性"和"记忆性"两个新的流动性测量指标，为代际流动性研究提供了更精细的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了美国社会流动性中隐藏的阶级分化模式，为理解社会不平等趋势提供了实证依据，对教育、劳动力市场和社会政策制定具有参考价值。

title: Loan-funded Loans: Equity-like Liabilities inside Bank Holding Companies
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business, University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and Tulane University

detail.title: Loan-funded Loans: Equity-like Liabilities inside Bank Holding Companies
detail.abstract:
Leveraging regulatory data on fund flows within bank holding companies (BHCs), we characterize internal loans as a critical funding source for commercial banks. Although recorded as bank liabilities, parent-to-bank internal loans function as contingent support that resembles capital. We show that internal-loan funded banks do not hoard liquidity; instead, they originate larger and longer-maturity loans at lower spreads, initiate more relationships with marginal borrowers, and retain larger shares in syndicated deals. Internal-loan-funded lending is followed by higher short-run profits but higher future nonperforming loan ratios. We further show that organizational structure shapes internal lending: in BHCs with both bank and nonbank operations, nonbank affiliates crowd out internal lending to banks and discipline banks’ use of internal funds, and these BHCs exhibit higher overall performance. To identify our tests, we exploit the passage of the Gramm–Leach–Bliley Act and the announcement of the Basel III Accord, using instrumental variables and discontinuity-design approaches. Our findings highlight an equity-like internal debt channel that shapes monetary policy transmission, risk-taking, and the role of organizational structure in banking.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，银行控股公司内部贷款作为关键融资来源，虽记录为负债但具有资本特征，影响银行贷款行为、风险承担和组织结构
AI.research_question: 银行控股公司内部贷款如何影响商业银行的贷款行为、风险承担和组织结构？
AI.motivation: 理解银行控股公司内部融资机制的实际作用和影响，特别是内部贷款作为资本替代品对银行行为和风险的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部融资理论、银行资本结构理论、组织经济学、监管套利理论
AI.method: 利用Gramm-Leach-Bliley法案和巴塞尔III协议作为准自然实验，采用工具变量法和断点回归设计
AI.findings: 内部贷款资助的银行不囤积流动性，而是发放更大规模、更长期限、更低利差的贷款，与边际借款人建立更多关系，在银团贷款中保留更大份额；短期利润更高但未来不良贷款率也更高；组织结构影响内部贷款分配
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"类股权的内部债务渠道"概念，揭示内部贷款作为资本替代品的作用机制，扩展对银行内部融资和组织结构的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供内部贷款监管依据，帮助银行优化内部资本配置，影响货币政策传导机制设计

title: Is Immigration Good for Health? The Effect of Immigration on Older Adult Mortality in the United States
affiliations: Harvard University - Department of Health Care Policy, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of Rochester

detail.title: Is Immigration Good for Health? The Effect of Immigration on Older Adult Mortality in the United States
detail.abstract: We measure the impact of increased immigration on mortality among elderly Americans, who rely on the immigrant-intensive health and long-term care sectors. Using a shift-share approach we find a strong impact of immigration on the size of the immigrant care workforce: admitting 1,000 new immigrants would lead to 142 new foreign healthcare workers, without evidence of crowd out of native health care workers. We also find striking effects on mortality: a 25% increase in the steady state flow of immigrants to the US would result in 5,000 fewer deaths nationwide. We identify reduced use of nursing homes as a key mechanism driving this result.

AI.tldr: 研究显示增加移民能显著降低美国老年人的死亡率，主要通过增加移民医疗工作者数量，减少养老院使用
AI.research_question: 增加移民对美国老年人死亡率有何影响？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国老年人依赖移民密集的医疗和长期护理行业，但移民政策对老年人健康结果的影响尚不清楚
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力供给理论、医疗资源可及性理论、移民对本地劳动力市场影响理论
AI.method: 采用shift-share方法分析移民对医疗劳动力市场的影响，并建立因果关系模型
AI.findings: 1) 每增加1000名移民会产生142名新的外国医疗工作者，无挤出效应；2) 移民流量增加25%可减少5000例全国死亡；3) 减少养老院使用是关键机制
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了移民通过增加医疗劳动力供给影响老年人健康结果的新机制，挑战了移民对本地劳动力市场负面影响的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定提供实证依据，显示宽松移民政策可改善老年人健康，减少医疗系统压力

title: Inferring Prices from Quantities
affiliations: Yale University, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: Inferring Prices from Quantities
detail.abstract:
Measuring aggregate inflation is subject to two opposing biases: unobserved quality and variety growth, and the use of incorrect weights when new varieties are misclassified. We show that it is possible to measure an aggregate price index free of these biases when we have a subset of products where these two errors average to zero. This procedure does not require us to distinguish new from existing goods, measure quality attributes directly, or classify new varieties into the appropriate category. We implement this approach using BEA data from 1959 to 2019, approximating the official PCE price index with a CES aggregate of BEA prices at the product level. Our estimate of the inflation rate exceeds the CES aggregate of BEA prices by 0.3 to 1.0 percentage points per year on average. The aggregate bias was close to zero prior to the BLS introducing hedonic adjustments, which suggests that only adjusting for quality bias can lead to an underestimation of overall inflation, particularly in quality-adjusted categories.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种测量总体价格指数的新方法，能够同时纠正质量偏差和权重偏差，避免了传统方法中需要区分新产品、直接测量质量属性或正确分类新产品的困难。
AI.research_question: 如何测量一个既不受未观测到的质量和品种增长偏差影响，也不受新产品错误分类权重偏差影响的总体价格指数？
AI.motivation: 测量总体通货膨胀存在两个相反的偏差：未观测到的质量和品种增长偏差（导致高估通胀），以及新产品被错误分类时使用错误权重导致的偏差（导致低估通胀）。传统方法难以同时纠正这两种偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CES（常替代弹性）加总框架，利用产品层面价格数据构建总体价格指数。理论核心是：当存在一个产品子集，其中两种偏差平均为零时，就可以测量出无偏的总体价格指数。
AI.method: 使用美国经济分析局（BEA）1959-2019年的数据，在BEA产品层面价格的基础上构建CES加总指数，近似官方PCE价格指数。通过识别偏差平均为零的产品子集来纠正总体偏差。
AI.findings: 估计的通胀率比BEA价格的CES加总指数平均每年高出0.3-1.0个百分点。在BLS引入享乐调整之前，总体偏差接近零，这表明仅调整质量偏差可能导致对总体通胀的低估，特别是在质量调整类别中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的理论方法，能够在不需要区分新产品、直接测量质量属性或正确分类新产品的情况下，同时纠正质量和权重两种偏差，为价格指数测量提供了更稳健的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和统计机构提供了更准确的通胀测量方法，揭示了传统享乐调整方法可能导致的系统性低估问题，对货币政策制定和通胀目标设定具有重要实践意义。

title: Optimal Trading in Automated Market Makers
affiliations: , Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics and Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Optimal Trading in Automated Market Makers
detail.abstract: We study optimal trading in automated market makers (AMMs), where immediate price impact is a mechanical nonlinear function of order size determined by a bonding curve. Unlike traditional linear impact models, AMM impact is state-dependent and asymmetric. We show that risk-neutral optimal trading problems can be reduced to simple pointwise optimizations via a transformation to “impact space.” We show that problems are well posed, provided price impact decays sufficiently quickly, a “no price-manipulation condition” comfortably satisfied when calibrated to trading data from Uniswap and Binance. We extend the analysis to optimal routing across centralized and decentralized venues. The effect of nonlinearities on optimal trades can be substantial in order-flow space, but essentially disappears when strategies are expressed in impact space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动做市商(AMM)中的最优交易问题，其中价格影响是非线性的状态依赖函数。通过转换到"影响空间"，将风险中性最优交易问题简化为点优化，并证明在满足"无价格操纵条件"时问题适定。研究还扩展到跨中心化和去中心化场所的最优路由。
AI.research_question: 在自动做市商(AMM)的非线性价格影响机制下，如何进行最优交易？如何将复杂的动态优化问题简化为可处理的点优化？
AI.motivation: 传统线性价格影响模型不适用于AMM，因为AMM的价格影响是由绑定曲线决定的非线性、状态依赖且不对称的函数。需要开发新的理论框架来处理AMM中的最优交易问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自动做市商(AMM)的绑定曲线理论，非线性价格影响模型，风险中性交易者假设，以及"影响空间"转换方法。
AI.method: 通过数学变换将复杂的动态优化问题转换到"影响空间"，将其简化为点优化问题。使用Uniswap和Binance的交易数据进行校准验证。
AI.findings: 1) 风险中性最优交易问题可通过"影响空间"转换简化为点优化；2) 当价格影响衰减足够快时(满足"无价格操纵条件")，问题适定；3) 非线性对订单流空间的最优交易影响显著，但在影响空间中基本消失；4) 方法可扩展到跨中心化和去中心化场所的最优路由。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了处理AMM非线性价格影响的新理论框架；2) 引入了"影响空间"转换方法简化复杂优化问题；3) 建立了AMM中"无价格操纵条件"的数学表述；4) 扩展了跨场所最优路由的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为AMM交易者提供了实用的最优交易策略；2) 帮助交易者在Uniswap等去中心化交易所优化执行；3) 为跨中心化和去中心化交易所的路由决策提供指导；4) 验证了实际交易数据满足理论条件。

title: Class Mobility in the Era of Rising Inequality: A Synthetic Dynasty Analysis
affiliations: University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility, University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility and University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility

detail.title: Class Mobility in the Era of Rising Inequality: A Synthetic Dynasty Analysis

declarations.funderStatement: This research has been supported by the James M. and Cathleen D. Stone Foundation.

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 26-02
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies contemporary trends in class mobility using a new approach based on the “synthetic dynasties” represented in Markov chains. This approach yields several novel measures of movement and memory, which respectively capture how class positions differ from one generation to the next and how the influence of class origins dissipates across generations. Applying these methods to data from the U.S., we find that overall levels of movement and memory have remained largely stable across cohorts born between 1945 and 1990. This stability, however, masks offsetting class-specific trends. Among those from the upper and lower classes, movement has declined and memory has increased. In contrast, among the middle classes, movement has risen and memory has weakened.

AI.tldr: 本文使用基于马尔可夫链的"合成王朝"新方法研究当代阶级流动性趋势，发现1945-1990年出生人群的整体流动性和阶级记忆保持稳定，但掩盖了阶级间的抵消趋势：上层和下层阶级流动性下降、记忆增强，而中产阶级流动性上升、记忆减弱。
AI.research_question: 当代阶级流动性趋势如何？不同阶级间的流动性和阶级记忆有何变化？
AI.motivation: 需要新的方法来更准确地测量代际阶级流动性和阶级记忆的消散过程，以理解当代社会流动性的变化模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于马尔可夫链的"合成王朝"方法，提出衡量阶级流动性和阶级记忆的新指标，关注代际阶级位置变化和阶级起源影响的消散过程。
AI.method: 使用基于马尔可夫链的"合成王朝"新方法，分析美国1945-1990年出生人群的数据，测量阶级流动性和阶级记忆的变化趋势。
AI.findings: 整体流动性和阶级记忆在1945-1990年出生人群中保持稳定，但存在阶级特异性趋势：上层和下层阶级流动性下降、记忆增强；中产阶级流动性上升、记忆减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于马尔可夫链的"合成王朝"新方法，开发了衡量阶级流动性和阶级记忆的新指标，为代际社会流动性研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了当代社会流动性的复杂模式，表明整体稳定性掩盖了不同阶级间的相反趋势，为理解社会不平等和社会政策制定提供了实证依据。

title: Do Perceptions Match Pollution Levels? Evidence from Three Indian Cities
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance, Northeastern University and Yale University

detail.title: Do Perceptions Match Pollution Levels? Evidence from Three Indian Cities

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2026-02
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how misperceptions of local air quality shape individual behavior and policy preferences in urban India. Using a pre-registered, online survey experiment with 2,117 respondents across three major cities, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Kolkata, we elicit subjective beliefs about local air quality and randomly provide a subset of participants with accurate Air Quality Index (AQI) data for their city. Participants then allocate real money between themselves and a tree-planting initiative and report support for various environmental policies. We document widespread, systematically biased misperceptions, with individuals in highly polluted cities often underestimating pollution risks. These misperceptions are correlated with lower environmental concern, lower policy support, and weaker climate beliefs. However, providing corrective information does not significantly shift either pro-environmental contributions or stated policy preferences. The only exception occurs among women, who exhibit increased support for environmental policies following treatment. Our findings highlight the limits of informational interventions in contexts of chronic pollution and suggest that misperceptions may reflect deeper patterns of disengagement from environmental issues.

AI.tldr: 研究印度城市居民对当地空气质量的错误认知如何影响其行为和政策偏好。通过在线调查实验发现，尽管人们普遍低估污染风险，但提供准确空气质量信息并不能显著改变环保捐款或政策支持，仅对女性有轻微影响。
AI.research_question: 当地空气质量错误认知如何影响印度城市居民的个人行为和政策偏好？提供准确信息能否纠正这些认知并改变行为？
AI.motivation: 印度城市面临严重空气污染问题，但公众对污染风险的认知可能存在偏差。理解这些认知偏差如何影响环保行为和政策支持，对于设计有效干预措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和信息干预理论，探讨认知偏差（特别是低估污染风险）如何影响环境态度和行为决策。
AI.method: 预注册在线调查实验，样本为2117名来自孟买、班加罗尔和加尔各答的受访者。随机分配实验组接受准确的空气质量指数信息，对照组不接受。测量主观信念、环保捐款分配和政策支持度。
AI.findings: 1. 普遍存在系统性认知偏差，高污染城市居民常低估污染风险；2. 错误认知与环境关注度低、政策支持弱、气候信念弱相关；3. 提供纠正信息对环保捐款和政策偏好无显著影响；4. 仅女性在治疗后表现出政策支持度增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在慢性污染背景下信息干预的局限性，表明错误认知可能反映了更深层次的环境问题疏离模式，挑战了单纯信息提供能改变行为的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重要启示：在严重污染环境中，仅靠信息宣传可能不足以改变行为，需要更综合的干预策略。性别差异表明需要针对性别的干预设计。

title: Revisiting Momentum through Dynamic Kernel Learning
affiliations: Siena College - School of Business and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Revisiting Momentum through Dynamic Kernel Learning
detail.abstract: This paper revisits momentum through a dynamic kernel framework that links return continuation to the speed at which return-relevant shocks propagate through prices. Using nearly sixty years of U.S. equity data, we estimate nonnegative and geometric kernels that govern how past returns are weighted over time. The estimated decay parameter rises sharply after 2000, indicating faster dissipation of return persistence and a shorter effective horizon for continuation, coinciding with the documented weakening of traditional 12–1 momentum. In out-of-sample tests, the structured kernel models match or outperform common machine-learning benchmarks while retaining economic interpretability, and these gains remain robust after controlling for volatility timing and trading frictions. The framework provides a parsimonious tool for tracking time variation in return propagation and for adapting momentum implementations to changing market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动态核框架重新审视动量效应，将收益持续性关联到收益相关冲击在价格中传播的速度。研究发现2000年后衰减参数显著上升，表明收益持续性更快消散，动量有效期限缩短，这与传统12-1动量效应减弱的现象一致。结构化核模型在样本外测试中匹配或优于常见机器学习基准，同时保持经济可解释性。
AI.research_question: 动量效应如何随时间变化？收益相关冲击在价格中的传播速度如何影响收益持续性？如何构建一个既能捕捉动量时间变化又保持经济可解释性的框架？
AI.motivation: 传统动量策略（如12-1动量）在2000年后表现减弱，需要理解动量效应的时间变化特征。现有方法要么过于简单（固定窗口），要么过于复杂（机器学习黑箱），缺乏既能捕捉动态变化又保持经济解释性的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态核框架理论，将动量效应建模为收益冲击在价格中的传播过程。核函数（非负几何核）控制过去收益的权重随时间衰减，衰减参数反映市场信息处理速度。
AI.method: 使用近60年美国股票数据，估计非负几何核函数参数。通过核衰减参数的时间变化分析动量持续性变化。进行样本外测试，比较结构化核模型与常见机器学习基准的表现，并控制波动率择时和交易摩擦。
AI.findings: 1. 衰减参数在2000年后显著上升，表明收益持续性更快消散，动量有效期限缩短；2. 这与传统12-1动量效应减弱的实证现象一致；3. 结构化核模型在样本外测试中匹配或优于机器学习基准；4. 模型优势在控制波动率择时和交易摩擦后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出动态核框架，将动量效应与收益冲击传播速度联系起来；2. 提供动量时间变化的理论解释机制；3. 建立衰减参数与市场信息处理效率的理论联系；4. 为动量效应的时间变化提供结构化建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供简洁工具追踪收益传播的时间变化；2. 帮助投资者根据市场条件调整动量策略实施；3. 结构化模型在保持经济可解释性的同时达到机器学习性能；4. 为动态动量策略设计提供实证指导。

title: Minimum Wages and Work Pressure
affiliations: University of Erlangen-Nuremberg-Friedrich Alexander Universität Erlangen Nürnberg and University of Erlangen-Nuremberg-Friedrich Alexander Universität Erlangen Nürnberg

detail.title: Minimum Wages and Work Pressure
detail.abstract: A large literature investigates the employment effects of minimum wages, with comparatively little evidence on other adjustment margins. In this paper, we analyze the impact of a nationwide introduction of minimum wages in Germany on employer-induced work pressure, using detailed worker-level survey data. Applying a difference-in-differences approach, we show that the introduction of minimum wages increased work pressure in occupations more exposed to the minimum wage. The increase in work pressure cannot be explained by compositional changes in terms of demographics, job complexity, or hours worked.

AI.tldr: 德国全国性最低工资政策实施后，研究发现最低工资暴露程度较高的职业中，雇主诱导的工作压力显著增加，且这种增加无法用人口特征、工作复杂性或工作时长等构成变化来解释。
AI.research_question: 德国全国性最低工资政策的引入如何影响雇主诱导的工作压力？
AI.motivation: 现有大量文献研究最低工资对就业的影响，但关于其他调整机制（如工作强度）的证据相对较少。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，探讨最低工资政策对工作压力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场调整理论，当企业面临最低工资上涨时，除了调整雇佣数量外，还可能通过提高工作强度来维持生产率。这涉及效率工资理论和工作强度调整机制。
AI.method: 使用详细的工人层面调查数据，采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences），比较最低工资暴露程度不同的职业在政策实施前后的工作压力变化。
AI.findings: 德国最低工资的引入显著增加了最低工资暴露程度较高职业中的工作压力。这种增加无法用人口特征、工作复杂性或工作时长等构成变化来解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了最低工资影响的研究范畴，从传统的就业效应延伸到工作强度调整机制，丰富了劳动力市场调整理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了最低工资政策可能带来的非预期后果（增加工作压力）的证据，有助于更全面地评估最低工资政策的综合影响。

title: Financial Market Inflation Perception and Firm Investments ∗
affiliations: and John Carroll University - Boler School of Business

detail.title: Financial Market Inflation Perception and Firm Investments ∗
detail.abstract: We estimate a measure of inflation perception based on the difference in inflation sensitivities across industry-based equity portfolios. Financial market inflation perception reflects how investors believe inflation will impact future earnings. We show that heightened inflation perception reduces future industrial production and output through firm investments. However, professional forecasters do not consider inflation perceptions when forming expectations about future economic activity. Finally, we discuss policy implications of the stabilizing effect that inflation perception has on the business cycle.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过行业股票组合的通胀敏感性差异衡量通胀感知，发现投资者通胀感知升高会通过企业投资减少未来工业生产和产出，但专业预测者未考虑通胀感知，通胀感知对商业周期有稳定作用
AI.research_question: 投资者通胀感知如何影响实体经济？专业预测者是否考虑通胀感知？通胀感知对商业周期有何政策含义？
AI.motivation: 理解金融市场通胀感知对实体经济的影响机制，以及专业预测者是否充分考虑了这种感知因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行业股票组合的通胀敏感性差异构建通胀感知指标，分析投资者通胀预期对企业投资决策的影响机制
AI.method: 通过行业股票组合的通胀敏感性差异估计通胀感知指标，实证分析通胀感知与未来工业生产、企业投资的关系
AI.findings: 1. 通胀感知升高会减少未来工业生产和产出；2. 这种影响主要通过企业投资渠道实现；3. 专业预测者在预测未来经济活动时未考虑通胀感知因素
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于金融市场数据的通胀感知测量方法，揭示了投资者通胀感知通过企业投资渠道影响实体经济的传导机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了通胀感知对商业周期的稳定作用；2. 建议专业预测者应将通胀感知纳入经济预测模型；3. 为企业投资决策提供通胀感知影响的参考

title: The War of Ideas: Institutions and Global Media Bias
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: The War of Ideas: Institutions and Global Media Bias
detail.abstract: We present the first systematic analysis of how countries cover each other in the news, using a newly constructed dataset of 55,240 media sources from 176 countries between 2015 and 2022, drawing upon a corpus of 1.4 billion online news articles. We document a pattern of global media bias: countries with greater differences in democracy levels systematically portray each other more negatively, shaping both the sentiment and thematic content of coverage. This bias is especially pronounced when less democratic countries report on liberal democracies, when state-controlled media is involved, or when the reporting country experiences economic downturns or political turmoil. We corroborate these findings exploiting episodes of democratic erosion in a difference-in-differences design. Using similarities in how countries report on third countries, we construct and introduce a novel granular measure of global media alliances. Finally, we show that cross-country media sentiment predicts subsequent public attitudes.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析了各国新闻媒体如何报道其他国家，基于2015-2022年176个国家55,240个媒体来源的14亿篇在线新闻文章。研究发现全球媒体存在系统性偏见：民主程度差异越大的国家，相互报道越负面，影响报道情感和主题内容。这种偏见在非民主国家报道自由民主国家、涉及国家控制媒体、或报道国经历经济衰退或政治动荡时尤为明显。研究还构建了全球媒体联盟的细粒度衡量指标，并发现跨国媒体情感能预测后续公众态度。
AI.research_question: 各国新闻媒体如何相互报道？是否存在系统性偏见？这种偏见受哪些因素影响？媒体情感如何影响公众态度？
AI.motivation: 虽然媒体偏见研究已有进展，但缺乏对跨国新闻报道的系统性分析。了解全球媒体如何相互报道对理解国际关系、公众舆论形成和民主进程至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主差异理论、媒体偏见理论、国际关系理论、公众舆论形成理论
AI.method: 基于大数据分析：使用2015-2022年176个国家55,240个媒体来源的14亿篇在线新闻文章构建数据集。采用双重差分设计验证民主侵蚀事件的影响。通过国家间对第三国报道的相似性构建全球媒体联盟衡量指标。
AI.findings:
1. 全球媒体存在系统性偏见：民主程度差异越大的国家相互报道越负面
2. 偏见在非民主国家报道自由民主国家时更明显
3. 国家控制媒体加剧偏见
4. 经济衰退和政治动荡时期偏见增强
5. 跨国媒体情感能预测后续公众态度
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次系统量化全球媒体偏见模式
2. 建立民主差异与媒体偏见的理论联系
3. 提出并验证全球媒体联盟的衡量方法
4. 连接媒体情感与公众态度的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供监测国际媒体报道的工具
2. 帮助媒体机构识别和减少偏见
3. 为公众提供理解国际新闻报道的框架
4. 为外交和国际关系实践提供参考

title: From Discrete Choice to Endogenous Distributions: Selection and Heterogeneity
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder

detail.title: From Discrete Choice to Endogenous Distributions: Selection and Heterogeneity
detail.abstract: This paper develops a tractable framework in which heterogeneity, captured by the distribution of agent characteristics within an alternative (sector, location, or occupation), emerges endogenously in equilibrium through selection rather than being imposed exogenously. I show that widely used extreme-value and power-law distributions arise as conditional outcomes of payoff-based discrete choice with multivariate shocks. The framework delivers a one-to-one mapping between equilibrium allocation shares and within-alternative heterogeneity. Because distributions are equilibrium objects, they respond to counterfactual shocks, introducing adjustment margins absent from standard models and generating richer responses, as shown in applications to trade, economic geography, and occupational sorting.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个可处理的框架，其中异质性（通过替代方案内代理特征的分布来捕捉）通过选择在均衡中内生出现，而不是外生强加。作者展示了广泛使用的极值分布和幂律分布作为具有多元冲击的基于收益的离散选择的条件下结果出现。该框架提供了均衡分配份额与替代方案内异质性之间的一对一映射。由于分布是均衡对象，它们对反事实冲击做出响应，引入了标准模型中不存在的调整边际，并产生更丰富的响应。
AI.research_question: 如何内生地解释经济模型中异质性的分布？广泛使用的极值分布和幂律分布如何从基于收益的离散选择模型中内生地出现？
AI.motivation: 现有经济模型通常将异质性分布作为外生假设，这限制了模型对政策冲击和反事实情景的预测能力。需要开发一个框架，使异质性分布能够在均衡中内生地出现，从而更好地理解经济主体选择行为的微观基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于收益的离散选择理论，多元冲击模型，均衡选择理论，异质性内生生成框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建一个可处理的框架，其中代理在替代方案（部门、地点或职业）之间做出离散选择，异质性分布通过选择过程在均衡中内生确定。
AI.findings: 1. 极值分布和幂律分布可以从具有多元冲击的基于收益的离散选择模型中内生地出现；2. 框架提供了均衡分配份额与替代方案内异质性之间的一对一映射；3. 由于分布是均衡对象，它们对反事实冲击做出响应；4. 这引入了标准模型中不存在的调整边际，产生更丰富的经济响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个异质性内生生成的统一框架；2. 为广泛使用的极值分布和幂律分布提供了微观基础；3. 建立了均衡分配与异质性分布之间的理论联系；4. 扩展了离散选择理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为贸易、经济地理和职业分类等领域的实证研究提供了更好的理论基础；2. 改进了政策冲击和反事实分析的方法；3. 增强了经济模型对现实世界异质性的解释能力；4. 为理解经济主体选择行为提供了更丰富的分析工具。

title: Land and Legality in the Darfur Conflict

detail.title: Land and Legality in the Darfur Conflict
detail.abstract: Land rights in Darfur act as a principal protagonist to the cause and maintenance of the ongoing armed conflict. The internal functioning and interaction of statutory, customary, and Islamic legal regimes regarding land have facilitated significant aspects of the war, and their reform will be fundamental to any effective peace process. This article describes the role of these legalities in the conflict. Subsequent to a description of the legal environment, the article examines the legal crisis regarding land rights, focusing on six aspects: the repercussions of a single law, the exclusionary customary system, profound confusion over concepts and terms, institutional disarray, and the peace accords.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了达尔富尔地区土地权利在武装冲突中的核心作用，分析了法定、习惯和伊斯兰三种法律体系在土地问题上的互动如何助长了冲突，并指出法律改革对和平进程至关重要。
AI.research_question: 达尔富尔地区法定、习惯和伊斯兰三种法律体系在土地权利方面的互动如何影响并维持了该地区的武装冲突？
AI.motivation: 土地权利在达尔富尔冲突中扮演关键角色，理解不同法律体系在土地问题上的相互作用对于解决冲突和建立有效和平进程至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律多元主义理论，分析法定法、习惯法和伊斯兰法三种法律体系在土地权利领域的互动与冲突。
AI.method: 法律环境描述与案例分析，聚焦六个方面：单一法律的影响、排他性习惯制度、概念术语的混淆、制度混乱以及和平协议。
AI.findings: 三种法律体系在土地权利上的冲突和混乱助长了达尔富尔武装冲突，法律体系的内在功能缺陷成为冲突持续的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对法律多元主义在冲突环境中作用的理解，揭示了法律体系内部矛盾如何转化为社会冲突的动力机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为达尔富尔和平进程提供了具体的法律改革方向，指出必须协调三种法律体系才能建立可持续的土地权利制度。

title: Land Rights under Stress in Darfur: A Volatile Dynamic of the Conflict
affiliations: University of Khartoum and

detail.title: Land Rights under Stress in Darfur: A Volatile Dynamic of the Conflict
detail.abstract: The aggravation of land rights over time in Darfur was a primary factor in the initiation of the confl ict, and has emerged as a particularly diffi cult set of issues in the search for viable peace. While the prospect of being able to keep land acquired in course of the confl ict was a primary factor in recruitment for the Janjaweed, it came on the heels of a set of changes in the environment, land use and population patterns, institutions, law and governance that produced a highly unwieldy and volatile land rights scenario. This article explores the role of land tenure in the Darfur confl ict, examining the aggravation of rights, custom, and law over time, and then focusing on two of the primary war-related tenure problems currently facing Darfur-use of land rights as tools of belligerence, and the land dispossession-secondary occupation problem.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨土地权属在达尔富尔冲突中的作用，分析土地权利、习俗和法律的恶化过程，重点关注战争相关的两个主要土地问题：将土地权利作为战争工具，以及土地剥夺与二次占用问题。
AI.research_question: 土地权属在达尔富尔冲突中扮演什么角色？土地权利、习俗和法律的恶化如何导致冲突？战争期间土地权利如何被用作战争工具？土地剥夺和二次占用问题如何影响和平进程？
AI.motivation: 达尔富尔冲突中土地权利的恶化是冲突爆发的主要因素，也是和平进程中最棘手的问题之一。了解土地权属在冲突中的作用对于寻找可行的和平解决方案至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地权属理论、冲突理论、制度变迁理论、环境-人口-治理互动框架
AI.method: 历史分析、制度分析、案例研究、文献分析
AI.findings: 1. 土地权利的长期恶化是达尔富尔冲突爆发的主要因素；2. 环境变化、土地利用模式、人口结构、制度和治理变化共同导致了高度不稳定和易爆发的土地权属局面；3. 能够在冲突中获得土地是Janjaweed民兵招募的主要诱因；4. 当前面临两个主要战争相关土地问题：土地权利作为战争工具，以及土地剥夺-二次占用问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对土地权属在冲突中作用的理解；2. 提出了环境-人口-制度-治理多维度分析框架；3. 揭示了土地权利恶化与冲突爆发的因果关系；4. 发展了战争期间土地权属动态的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为达尔富尔和平进程提供土地问题解决方案；2. 帮助政策制定者理解土地权属在冲突中的核心作用；3. 为解决土地剥夺和二次占用问题提供政策建议；4. 为其他类似冲突地区的土地问题治理提供借鉴。

title: Salience Theory, Rollover Risk and Credit Spread
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Salience Theory, Rollover Risk and Credit Spread
detail.abstract: We develops a behavioral-structural model of credit risk that integrates investor salience bias into a dynamic rollover risk framework. We show that investors' overweighting of salient default states underprices newly issued bonds, increasing rollover losses and endogenously motivating early default. This mechanism generates realistic spreads and captures the non-linear "crisis multiplier" effect during liquidity shocks. We uncover "safety premium erosion", where high-quality bonds are more sensitive to salience distortions. Calibrating the model to China reveals a stark dichotomy: AAA bonds are priced near-rationally due to implicit government guarantees suppressing default salience, whereas Non-AAA bonds bear the full brunt of behavioral overreaction. This highlights the critical interaction between behavioral bias and institutional support in pricing credit risk.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个行为-结构信用风险模型，将投资者的显著性偏差整合到动态展期风险框架中，揭示了投资者对显著违约状态的过度关注导致新发行债券定价过低，增加展期损失并内生性地促使提前违约。
AI.research_question: 投资者显著性偏差如何影响信用风险定价和展期风险？行为偏差与制度支持如何相互作用决定债券定价？
AI.motivation: 传统信用风险模型未能充分考虑投资者的行为偏差，特别是对显著违约状态的过度关注如何影响债券定价和展期风险动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学（显著性偏差理论）、动态展期风险理论、信用风险定价模型、行为-结构整合框架
AI.method: 构建行为-结构信用风险模型，整合投资者显著性偏差到动态展期风险框架中，进行理论推导和数值模拟，并针对中国市场进行校准分析。
AI.findings: 1. 投资者对显著违约状态的过度关注导致新发行债券定价过低，增加展期损失并内生性地促使提前违约；2. 该机制能生成现实的利差并捕捉流动性冲击时的非线性"危机乘数"效应；3. 发现"安全溢价侵蚀"现象，高质量债券对显著性扭曲更敏感；4. 中国市场校准显示明显二分：AAA债券因隐性政府担保抑制违约显著性而接近理性定价，非AAA债券则承受行为过度反应的全部冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了整合行为偏差和结构风险的新信用风险模型；2. 揭示了显著性偏差如何内生性地影响违约决策；3. 提出了"安全溢价侵蚀"的新概念；4. 阐明了行为偏差与制度支持的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了理解债券定价中行为偏差影响的框架；2. 帮助监管机构识别系统性风险来源；3. 为中国市场债券定价提供了行为视角的解释；4. 强调了制度支持在抑制行为过度反应中的重要作用。

title: Using Life Satisfaction Data to Measure Parents' Child Gender Preferences
affiliations: , Princeton University and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Using Life Satisfaction Data to Measure Parents' Child Gender Preferences
detail.abstract: Can questions about life satisfaction be used to measure parental preferences for daughters versus sons? Daughter preference has rarely been documented in the literature, even in matrilineal settings. One possible reason is that the commonly used measures of parental gender preference, such as fertility-stopping rules and sex ratio at birth, are ill-suited to high-fertility settings. We instead assess maternal preferences in Malawi by examining the life satisfaction of women who currently have one child, comparing those with a daughter to those with a son. We find that in matrilineal (but not patrilineal) households, having a daughter increases mothers' life satisfaction, relative to having a son.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析母亲的生活满意度来测量父母对女儿与儿子的偏好，发现在母系社会中，拥有女儿会提高母亲的生活满意度，而在父系社会中则无此效应。
AI.research_question: 生活满意度问题能否用来测量父母对女儿与儿子的偏好？在母系社会中，母亲是否更偏好女儿？
AI.motivation: 现有文献很少记录女儿偏好，即使在母系社会中也是如此。可能原因是常用的父母性别偏好测量方法（如生育停止规则和出生性别比）不适合高生育率环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别偏好理论和社会文化背景（母系vs父系社会）对父母偏好的影响。
AI.method: 在马拉维，通过比较目前只有一个孩子的母亲的生活满意度，分析那些有女儿的母亲与有儿子的母亲之间的差异。
AI.findings: 在母系（而非父系）家庭中，拥有女儿相对于拥有儿子会提高母亲的生活满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的测量父母性别偏好的方法（生活满意度），并证实了在特定社会文化背景下存在女儿偏好。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更有效的工具来评估性别偏好，特别是在高生育率环境中，有助于设计更精准的性别平等政策。

title: Constituencies of Conflict and Opportunity: Land Rights, Narratives and Collective Action in Darfur

detail.title: Constituencies of Conflict and Opportunity: Land Rights, Narratives and Collective Action in Darfur
detail.abstract: Grievance-based narratives are a primary component of civil wars. While present among the general population affected by conflict, the variants held by the segment of the population most proximate to the armed factions e constituencies e play a primary role in the development and conduct of a conflict. Such narratives can coalesce around specific volatile issues and enable non-combatant constituencies to participate in the conflict through the use of specific 'legalities' or legal precepts. These legalities facilitate the engagement of sets of collective action that are opposed to those derived by constituencies of the opposing side. However such constituencies and their narratives are also where potential opportunity resides for peace-building, both during and subsequent to hostilities. This article looks at the case of Darfur to examine these ingredients, with a focus on land rights as the volatile set of issues around which narratives have developed. In Darfur, opposed narratives which maintain how and why groups claim and deserve access to land and territory, and how groups were unjustly displaced or excluded from lands (and hence power), became solidified and acted upon prior to the conflict to become a primary driver in the current war. In certain cases however narrative change has led to interaction between members of opposed constituencies for the purpose of exploring cooperative arrangements.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究平民叙事在冲突中的作用，以达尔富尔为案例，聚焦土地权利作为核心争议问题，探讨叙事如何驱动战争又为和平创造机会。
AI.research_question: 平民叙事如何通过特定"合法性"框架在冲突中发挥作用，以及这些叙事如何既驱动冲突又为和平建设提供机会？
AI.motivation: 理解平民叙事在冲突中的关键作用，特别是围绕土地权利等争议问题的叙事如何成为战争的主要驱动力，同时探索这些叙事如何转化为和平建设的潜在机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平民叙事理论、集体行动理论、合法性框架理论，探讨叙事如何通过特定"合法性"概念组织非战斗人员参与冲突。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以达尔富尔冲突为具体案例，分析围绕土地权利形成的对立叙事及其在冲突中的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 平民叙事围绕土地权利等争议问题形成对立框架；2. 这些叙事通过特定"合法性"概念使非战斗人员能够参与冲突；3. 对立叙事在冲突前就已固化并成为战争主要驱动力；4. 在某些情况下，叙事变化导致对立群体成员为探索合作安排而互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对平民叙事在冲突中作用的理解；2. 提出了"合法性"作为叙事组织集体行动的机制；3. 扩展了叙事理论在冲突与和平研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冲突调解提供叙事分析的视角；2. 识别和平建设的潜在切入点；3. 为达尔富尔等地区的冲突解决提供具体启示。

title: The Role of Land Resource Rights in the Maximization of Adaptation Investments: The Example of Darfur

detail.title: The Role of Land Resource Rights in the Maximization of Adaptation Investments: The Example of Darfur
detail.abstract: Adaptations to environmental change for rural inhabitants of the developing world will inevitably involve a change in the way resources are used. Because all resource use operates through systems of rights of access, claim and use, such systems can either facilitate adaptation—resulting in a maximization of benefits—or subvert adaptation, crippling its potential and even producing negative outcomes. Resources used in new ways in adaptation scenarios will necessitate modifications in resource rights, and importantly, change in resource rights relationships between groups—communities, lineages, tribes, livelihoods, production systems, commercial interests, and the state. For the benefits of investments in adaptations to be maximized, changing systems of resource rights will need to be engaged by policy efforts in ways that support adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了发展中国家农村居民适应环境变化时资源使用权系统如何影响适应效果，指出资源使用权系统的改变是适应过程的关键，需要政策干预来支持适应。
AI.research_question: 资源使用权系统如何影响发展中国家农村居民的环境变化适应过程？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家农村居民面临环境变化时，资源使用方式的改变必然涉及资源使用权系统的调整，这些系统可能促进适应（最大化效益）或阻碍适应（产生负面结果），因此需要理解其作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源使用权理论、适应理论、制度变迁理论、社会-生态系统理论
AI.method: 基于摘要推断：理论分析/概念框架构建，可能结合案例研究或文献综述
AI.findings: 1. 资源使用权系统在环境适应中起关键作用，可能促进或阻碍适应效果；2. 新的资源使用方式需要资源使用权的修改；3. 资源使用权关系的改变涉及多个社会群体间的互动；4. 政策需要积极介入资源使用权系统的变革以支持适应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将资源使用权系统与环境适应过程理论联系；2. 提出资源使用权系统作为适应过程的关键中介变量；3. 构建了资源使用权变革与适应结果关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供指导：在环境适应投资中需要关注资源使用权系统的变革；2. 强调政策需要积极管理资源使用权关系的变化；3. 为农村发展实践提供资源管理的新视角。

title: Rigidity and Default in Production Networks
affiliations: , Politecnico di Torino, Politecnico di Torino, Luiss University Dipartimento di Economia e Finanza and University of Turin - Esomas Department

detail.title: Rigidity and Default in Production Networks
detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of shocks on production networks, when firms in different sectors have imperfect information, face rigid production decisions, and rely on external debt. Rigidity breaks the Modigliani-Miller irrelevance of leverage and may generate default when shocks occur, even in equilibrium. The economy features firms, banks, and consumers. We prove that, under proportional shock transmission, a unique Walrasian rigid equilibrium exists, and we explicitly characterize its quantities and prices, including the equilibrium interest rate. This characterization shows that welfare in the rigid equilibrium is smaller than in the first best and that Hulten's theorem fails under rigidity. Moreover, quantities are decreasing and prices increasing in the total cost of debt. Leverage affects equilibrium outcomes even before shocks occur: it has inflationary effects on the levered sectors, which propagate downstream, and it shifts consumption upstream. The occurrence of default just depends on the real shocks and the network structure, while the magnitude of the losses depends also on the connectedness of the economy and the cost of debt of the connected sectors. We provide conditions for default cascades to occur and study two examples of default propagation.

AI.tldr: 研究生产网络中冲击的影响，考虑企业信息不完全、生产决策刚性和依赖外部债务的情况。刚性打破了杠杆的莫迪利亚尼-米勒无关性，可能导致违约。研究发现杠杆在冲击发生前就影响均衡结果，具有通胀效应，并改变消费模式。
AI.research_question: 当不同行业的企业面临不完全信息、刚性生产决策和依赖外部债务时，冲击如何影响生产网络？杠杆如何影响均衡结果？违约如何传播？
AI.motivation: 传统生产网络模型通常假设完全信息和灵活调整，但现实中企业面临信息不完全、生产决策刚性（如长期合同）和依赖外部融资。这些摩擦可能放大冲击的影响，导致违约和连锁反应，需要新的理论框架来分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 生产网络理论；2. 不完全信息下的企业决策；3. 刚性生产决策理论；4. 债务和违约理论；5. 瓦尔拉斯均衡框架；6. 莫迪利亚尼-米勒定理的失效；7. 赫尔顿定理的失效
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建包含企业、银行和消费者的生产网络模型，假设企业面临不完全信息、刚性生产决策和外部债务。证明在比例冲击传递下存在唯一的瓦尔拉斯刚性均衡，并明确表征其数量和价格（包括均衡利率）。通过比较静态分析和案例研究分析违约传播。
AI.findings: 1. 刚性均衡的福利低于最优水平；2. 赫尔顿定理在刚性下失效；3. 杠杆在冲击发生前就影响均衡：对杠杆部门有通胀效应，并向下游传播，同时将消费向上游转移；4. 违约发生仅取决于实际冲击和网络结构，但损失大小还取决于经济连通性和相关部门的债务成本；5. 提供了违约级联发生的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含不完全信息、刚性和债务的生产网络理论框架；2. 证明了刚性均衡的存在性和唯一性；3. 揭示了刚性如何打破莫迪利亚尼-米勒无关性；4. 展示了赫尔顿定理在刚性下的失效；5. 提供了违约传播的理论条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解冲击在生产网络中的传播提供分析工具；2. 帮助企业评估杠杆决策的风险；3. 为监管机构设计金融稳定政策提供理论依据；4. 有助于理解债务成本如何影响价格和资源配置。

title: The Insurance Value of Public Insurance Against Idiosyncratic Income Risk
affiliations: and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Insurance Value of Public Insurance Against Idiosyncratic Income Risk
detail.abstract: The tax and transfer system partially insures households against individual income risk. We build a framework to assess the size and (welfare) value of this partial insurance, which is based on exploiting distributional differences between household gross income and disposable income. Our approach flexibly accounts for these differences and does not require the specification of a tax function. The key feature of the model around which our framework is built is that the degree of partial insurance is directly parameterized, which allows us to solve for the degree of insurance provided by the tax and transfer system as a fixed point. Our approach works with standard homothetic preferences, and is flexible regarding the distributions of income shocks. Only in the nested special case of homoskedastic log-Normal distributions, the ratio of the dispersion of permanent shocks to gross and disposable incomes provides a sufficient statistic for the degree of government-provided consumption insurance. In an application to data from Swedish tax registers, we find that the degree of partial insurance against permanent shocks by the tax and transfer system amounts to about 49%. Resorting to the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we also document that the model-based measure aligns well with empirical estimates based on survey data on consumption, implying a degree of insurance of about 25% in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个评估税收和转移支付系统对家庭收入风险提供部分保险程度的框架，通过比较家庭总收入与可支配收入的分布差异来量化这种保险效应，无需指定具体的税收函数。应用瑞典和美国数据发现，税收系统对永久性冲击的保险程度分别为49%和25%。
AI.research_question: 税收和转移支付系统在多大程度上为家庭收入风险提供了部分保险？如何量化这种政府提供的消费保险程度？
AI.motivation: 税收和转移支付系统作为重要的社会保障机制，能够部分平滑家庭收入波动，但现有研究缺乏灵活的方法来准确量化这种保险效应，特别是在不需要指定具体税收函数的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭总收入与可支配收入分布差异的分析框架，直接参数化部分保险程度，使用标准同质偏好假设，对收入冲击分布具有灵活性。在嵌套的对数正态分布同方差特殊情况下，永久冲击对总收入与可支配收入的分散度比率成为政府提供消费保险的充分统计量。
AI.method: 构建理论框架，通过比较家庭总收入与可支配收入的分布差异来量化部分保险程度，将保险程度作为固定点求解。应用瑞典税收登记数据和美国收入动态面板研究(PSID)数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 瑞典税收系统对永久性冲击的保险程度约为49%，美国约为25%。模型基于的测量与基于消费调查数据的实证估计结果吻合良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了灵活评估税收系统保险效应的新框架；2) 无需指定具体税收函数；3) 直接参数化保险程度；4) 在特殊情况下识别出充分统计量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了量化税收系统保险效应的实用工具；2) 揭示了瑞典和美国税收系统在平滑收入风险方面的差异；3) 方法适用于不同国家的税收系统评估。

title: Integrating Granular Data into a Multilayer Network: An Interbank Model of the Euro Area for Systemic Risk Assessment
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Integrating Granular Data into a Multilayer Network: An Interbank Model of the Euro Area for Systemic Risk Assessment
detail.abstract: Micro-structural models of contagion and systemic risk emphasize that shock propagation is inherently multi-channel, spanning counterparty exposures, short-term funding and roll-over risk, securities crossholdings, and common-asset (fire-sale) spillovers. Empirical implementations, however, often rely on stylized or simulated networks, or focus on a single exposure dimension, reflecting the practical difficulty of reconciling heterogeneous granular collections into a coherent representation with consistent identifiers and consolidation rules. We close part of this gap by constructing an empirically grounded multilayer network for euro area significant banking groups that integrates several supervisory and statistical datasets into layer-consistent exposure matrices defined on a common node set. Each layer corresponds to a distinct transmission channel, long-and short-term credit, securities cross-holdings, short-term secured funding, and overlapping external portfolios, and nodes are enriched with balance-sheet information to support model calibration. We document pronounced cross-layer heterogeneity in connectivity and centrality, and show that an aggregated (flattened) representation can mask economically relevant structure and misidentify the institutions that are systemically important in specific markets. We then illustrate how the resulting network disciplines standard systemic-risk analytics by implementing a centrality-based propagation measure and a micro-structural agent-based framework on real exposures. The approach provides a data-grounded basis for layer-aware systemic-risk assessment and stress testing across multiple dimensions of the banking network.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多层网络模型，整合欧元区重要银行集团的多维度风险暴露数据，揭示不同传染渠道的网络结构异质性，并展示了基于真实数据的系统性风险分析方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个实证基础的多层网络来整合银行系统的多维度风险暴露，并分析不同传染渠道对系统性风险的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有系统性风险研究通常依赖简化网络或单一风险维度，难以反映现实中多通道传染的复杂性。实际数据整合面临标识不一致、数据异质性等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微观结构传染理论，强调风险传播的多通道性：对手方暴露、短期融资风险、证券交叉持有、共同资产抛售溢出等。
AI.method: 整合多个监管和统计数据集，构建欧元区重要银行集团的多层网络，每层对应不同的传染渠道，节点包含资产负债表信息以支持模型校准。
AI.findings: 发现不同风险层在连通性和中心性方面存在显著异质性；聚合的网络表示可能掩盖经济相关结构，并错误识别特定市场中的系统重要性机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个实证基础的多层网络框架，能够更准确地捕捉系统性风险的多维度特性，为层感知的风险评估提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了基于真实数据的系统性风险分析工具，支持跨多个维度的压力测试和层感知的风险评估，有助于更精准地识别系统重要性机构。

title: Common Property and Conflict in Ethiopia: The Case of the Afar, Somali, and Karamojong Cluster Pastoralists

detail.title: Common Property and Conflict in Ethiopia: The Case of the Afar, Somali, and Karamojong Cluster Pastoralists
detail.abstract: Pastoralism is a primary form of livelihood on the Horn of Africa and pastoral commons are particularly difficult in terms of conflict and conflict resolution (Fratkin, 1994; Gebre-Mariam,  1994; Ocan, 1994; Salih, 1994; Unruh, 1995a). Common property resources (CPRs) play a fundamental role in pastoral livelihood, identity, and conflict (Gadamu, 1994; Gebre-Mariam, 1994; Ocan, 1994; Salih, 1994; Unruh, 1995b). Because few institutions can endure the stresses  of armed conflict (Ostrom, 1999), conflict prone areas such as the Horn can seem particularly distant from opportunities to derive workable institutional arrangements able to effectively manage contested commonly held land.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了非洲之角地区冲突环境下公共财产资源（CPRs）管理的制度安排挑战，特别是游牧生计与冲突之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 在冲突频发的非洲之角地区，如何建立有效的制度安排来管理有争议的公共财产资源？
AI.motivation: 游牧是非洲之角的主要生计方式，但公共牧场在冲突和冲突解决方面特别困难，而冲突环境下的制度安排尤为脆弱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财产资源（CPRs）理论、制度经济学（Ostrom）、冲突与资源管理理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述（Fratkin, 1994; Gebre-Mariam, 1994; Ocan, 1994; Salih, 1994; Unruh, 1995a,b; Ostrom, 1999）的理论分析。
AI.findings: 冲突地区（如非洲之角）的制度难以承受武装冲突的压力，使得建立有效管理公共土地的制度安排显得特别遥远。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了冲突环境下公共财产资源管理的理论框架，强调了制度脆弱性与冲突强度的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突地区的资源管理和冲突解决提供了政策启示，强调了在冲突环境中建立可持续制度安排的重要性。

title: The Dilemma of Local Level Land Tenure in the Peace Process

detail.title: The Dilemma of Local Level Land Tenure in the Peace Process
detail.abstract:
The disintegration of land tenure institutions during armed conflict, and yet the importance 
of property, land, homeland, and territory to the cause and conduct of conflict presents 
particular dilemmas for a peace process attempting to reconfigure important aspects of 
social relations. While land issues can be at the center of many civil conflicts, in 
subsequent peace efforts they are most frequently addressed in a general framework 
presented in peace accords, or national-level legislative change. However how land tenure 
issues play out institutionally across the landscape at the level of the community, 
household, and individual is not part of peace process 'packages' operated by the 
international community. Important operative aspects of land tenure during a peace 
process remain unexamined, and there exists a lack of theoretical and applied tools to 
address local tenurial issues in the context of postwar social relations. This is of particular 
concern given the general recognition that the character of current instability often 
comprises low intensity conflict within nations rather than between them, with their origins 
buried deep within aggravating problems of inequitable access to resources--including, and 
often particularly, land resources.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了武装冲突期间土地产权制度的解体问题，指出土地问题在和平进程中往往只停留在宏观政策层面，而缺乏对社区、家庭和个人层面的制度性关注，需要开发理论和应用工具来解决战后社会关系中的地方性土地问题。
AI.research_question: 在战后和平进程中，如何解决地方层面的土地产权制度问题，特别是社区、家庭和个人层面的土地权属安排？
AI.motivation: 土地问题常常是内战的核心，但在和平进程中通常只通过和平协议或国家立法等宏观框架处理，忽视了地方层面的制度性安排。当前的不稳定往往源于国内资源分配不均，特别是土地资源，因此需要关注地方层面的土地产权问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地产权制度理论、冲突后社会重建理论、资源分配公平理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 未明确说明具体方法，但从内容推断可能采用案例研究、制度分析、比较分析等方法
AI.findings: 和平进程中的土地问题处理存在制度性缺失：国际社会的和平进程"套餐"忽视了社区、家庭和个人层面的土地产权制度安排；缺乏解决战后社会关系中地方性土地问题的理论和应用工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了关注地方层面土地产权制度在和平进程中的重要性；填补了战后社会关系中土地问题研究的理论空白；为理解资源分配不均与冲突的关系提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了当前和平进程在处理土地问题上的局限性；呼吁开发适用于地方层面的土地问题解决工具；为政策制定者提供了改进和平进程中土地问题处理的建议。

title: Financing Circular Textile Infrastructure in Nigeria and ECOWAS: From Prohibition and Informality to Bankable Waste and Industrial Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Financing Circular Textile Infrastructure in Nigeria and ECOWAS: From Prohibition and Informality to Bankable Waste and Industrial Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Ehimare Recycling, a company engaged in textile reuse and recycling operations in Europe. This paper does not advocate for the interests of any specific firm and does not propose preferential access or exemptions for market participants. The analysis and policy framework presented apply equally to all operators and are intended to inform public policy and development finance discussions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary data analysis, policy documents, and publicly available sources. It did not involve human participants, patient data, or primary data collection requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was not funded by any external grant, donor, or commercial entity. The work was undertaken independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Nigeria and the wider West African region face a persistent and interlinked set of challenges at the intersection of waste management, textile trade, and industrial development. Rapid urbanisation, rising consumption, and changing trade patterns have significantly increased the volume and complexity of municipal waste, while policy responses have struggled to keep pace. Within this broader challenge, textiles, particularly second-hand clothing, occupy a distinctive and politically sensitive position. They provide affordable garments and support extensive livelihoods, yet also contribute to industrial displacement, rising waste volumes, and unfunded environmental and municipal costs.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚及西非地区面临废物管理、纺织品贸易和工业发展交织的复杂挑战，快速城市化、消费增长和贸易模式变化导致废物量激增，政策应对滞后。二手服装贸易在提供廉价衣物和生计的同时，也带来工业替代、废物增加和环境成本问题。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚及西非地区如何应对废物管理、纺织品贸易和工业发展之间的复杂互动关系，特别是在二手服装贸易带来的经济、社会和环境多重影响方面？
AI.motivation: 该地区面临快速城市化、消费增长和贸易模式变化带来的废物管理挑战，政策应对滞后。二手服装贸易在经济利益（提供廉价衣物和生计）与环境成本（工业替代、废物增加）之间存在矛盾，需要系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可能涉及循环经济理论、贸易与环境关系理论、可持续发展理论、政策滞后理论，以及废物管理-工业发展-贸易互动的系统框架。
AI.method: 可能采用混合研究方法：定量分析（废物数据、贸易统计）、定性分析（政策文件、利益相关者访谈）、案例研究（尼日利亚及西非地区），以及系统分析方法。
AI.findings: 二手服装贸易具有双重性：一方面提供经济和社会效益（廉价衣物、生计支持），另一方面导致本地工业替代、废物量增加，并产生未获资助的环境和市政成本。政策应对滞后于快速变化的社会经济现实。
AI.theory_contributions: 对贸易-环境-工业发展的复杂互动关系提供理论框架，丰富循环经济理论在发展中国家背景下的应用，深化对政策滞后现象的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及西非地区政策制定者提供综合解决方案建议，平衡二手服装贸易的经济利益与环境成本，促进可持续废物管理和工业发展政策。

title: From Biodegradable Living to Plastic Urbanism: Historical Roots of Recycling Behaviour in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Biodegradable Living to Plastic Urbanism: Historical Roots of Recycling Behaviour in Sub-Saharan Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: Recycling challenges in Sub-Saharan Africa are often attributed to inadequate infrastructure, weak governance, and limited financing. While important, these explanations do not fully account for persistently low participation in waste separation and formal recycling systems, even where such systems exist. This paper proposes a behavioural-historical explanation for this gap. It argues that pre-urban African societies developed waste practices that were ecologically rational within environments composed almost entirely of biodegradable materials. Organic refuse such as food remnants, ash, and natural fibres safely reintegrated into the soil, shaping practical understandings of how waste behaved in the environment. Over generations, these ecological experiences formed enduring cultural assumptions that discarded materials naturally "return to the land." With rapid urbanisation and the widespread introduction of plastics, synthetics, metals, and electronic waste, these historically adaptive practices have become environmentally maladaptive. However, behavioural norms have not evolved at the same pace as material conditions. Drawing on behavioural science and circular economy scholarship, this paper explains how habitual cognition and social norms contribute to the persistence of mixed dumping, informal burning, and limited adoption of recycling practices. The paper introduces the Behavioural Waste Transition Model (BWTM), a conceptual framework linking historical ecology, cultural memory, and contemporary waste behaviour. It explains why recycling models transferred from industrialised contexts often underperform and proposes a staged behavioural transition beginning with material recognition rather than immediate waste separation. The framework offers policy insights and a foundation for future empirical research into culturally informed circular economy transitions in African cities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出行为-历史解释框架，认为撒哈拉以南非洲的回收挑战源于历史上适应生物降解环境的生态理性实践，这些实践在现代非生物降解材料时代变得不适应，但行为规范未能同步演变。
AI.research_question: 为什么撒哈拉以南非洲地区即使在存在正式回收系统的情况下，废弃物分类和回收参与率仍然持续偏低？
AI.motivation: 传统解释（基础设施不足、治理薄弱、资金有限）无法充分解释回收参与率低的问题，需要从行为和历史角度寻找更深层原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为科学、循环经济理论、历史生态学、文化记忆理论，以及作者提出的行为废弃物转型模型（BWTM）。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，结合行为科学和循环经济文献，提出行为废弃物转型模型（BWTM）。
AI.findings: 历史上适应生物降解环境的生态理性实践形成了"废弃物自然回归土地"的文化假设，这些行为规范在现代非生物降解材料时代变得不适应，导致混合倾倒、非正式焚烧等行为持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了行为废弃物转型模型（BWTM），将历史生态、文化记忆与当代废弃物行为联系起来，解释了从工业化国家移植的回收模式为何在非洲表现不佳。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议从材料识别而非立即废弃物分类开始的分阶段行为转型策略，为非洲城市文化敏感的循环经济转型提供政策见解和研究基础。

title: Postconflict Geographies

detail.title: Postconflict Geographies
detail.abstract: The powerful spatial aspects of armed conflict and its repercussions create the particular features that constitute postconflict geography. Wars are almost always about some form of spatial contest and control. While the focus of armed encounter on military objectives does influence the postconflict period, it is the profound disruption of economic, livelihood, ethnic, and identity-based attachments to, and dependencies on, particular landscapes that constitute the greater domain of postconflict geographies. The sociospatial repercussions of violence, dislocation, lack of access to and destruction of lands and properties, together with the breakdown of formal and customary institutions that manage land, property, and territory, have a much more pervasive and lasting impact on postconflict geography than the aggregate repercussions of battlefield encounter (Holbrooke 1998). Chronologically, these repercussions begin with the control and negotiation over the spatial spoils of war (landscape-based resources and locations that are or will become valuable), and continue with large-scale population return to areas of origin from which dislocation occurred, and the subsequent focus of war-affected populations on the pursuit of postwar livelihoods, including interaction with areas containing landmines. How wars end can influence certain aspects of postconflict geography, but generally wars come to a close through either a peace accord or victory. As a civil war moves toward a ceasefire The International Encyclopedia of Geography.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨武装冲突的空间维度如何塑造战后地理特征，强调社会经济破坏比战场直接影响更具持久性影响。
AI.research_question: 武装冲突的空间维度如何构成战后地理特征？社会经济破坏与战场直接影响相比，哪个对战后地理的影响更持久？
AI.motivation: 现有研究可能过于关注战场军事影响，而忽视了战争对经济、生计、族群关系和身份认同等社会空间维度的破坏，这些才是构成战后地理的核心特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后冲突地理学理论，强调空间控制、社会经济破坏、制度崩溃等维度对战后地理的塑造作用。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念框架构建，基于文献综述和案例分析（如Holbrooke 1998的引用）。
AI.findings: 1. 战争的空间争夺与控制构成战后地理基础；2. 社会经济破坏比战场直接影响更持久；3. 制度崩溃加剧空间管理问题；4. 人口流动和生计重建是战后地理关键过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了后冲突地理学的理论框架，强调社会经济维度的重要性，挑战了传统以军事影响为中心的分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战后重建政策提供指导：应优先关注社会经济恢复、土地财产权利重建、制度修复，而不仅仅是军事安全。

title: Healthcare Workforce Needs in Italy. Challenges of Generational Turnover and the Impact of NRRP Interventions
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Healthcare Workforce Needs in Italy. Challenges of Generational Turnover and the Impact of NRRP Interventions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 982
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper offers an overview of the current supply and projected demand for healthcare personnel in Italy, with a particular focus on the challenges arising from the country’s ageing population. Following a comparative assessment of Italy’s position relative to major European nations, the study examines the evolution of healthcare staffing across Italy’s macro-regions between 2011 and 2022, highlighting persistent territorial disparities. The analysis encompasses not only Italian public health service personnel but also contracted physicians and staff working in public-equivalent and accredited private facilities. A comparative evaluation of facilities by medical specialty reveals that the public and private sectors tend to function in a complementary rather than a substitutive manner. Furthermore, the paper estimates future workforce requirements over the next decade, considering both retirements and the implementation of initiatives aimed at strengthening community-based care, as outlined in the NRRP. Ultimately, the findings underscore a growing misalignment between the demand for specific healthcare roles and the available supply, a gap further widened by training programmes that are not consistently aligned with long-term strategic needs.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了意大利医疗人员的供需现状及未来十年需求预测，重点关注老龄化挑战、地区差异、公私部门互补性，以及培训项目与长期战略需求不匹配的问题。
AI.research_question: 意大利医疗人员供需现状如何？未来十年医疗人员需求与供给之间是否存在错配？公私医疗部门在人员配置上是替代还是互补关系？
AI.motivation: 意大利面临人口老龄化加剧的挑战，需要评估医疗人员供需状况，识别地区差异，为制定长期医疗人力资源战略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗人力资源规划理论、供需匹配理论、公私部门互补性理论、区域发展不平衡理论。
AI.method: 比较分析（意大利与主要欧洲国家）、时间序列分析（2011-2022年）、区域差异分析（意大利各大区）、公私部门对比分析、未来需求预测模型（考虑退休和社区医疗政策）。
AI.findings: 1. 意大利医疗人员存在持续的地区差异；2. 公私医疗部门呈现互补而非替代关系；3. 未来十年特定医疗角色需求与供给存在日益扩大的错配；4. 培训项目与长期战略需求不一致加剧了供需矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对医疗人力资源供需错配机制的理解，提出了公私部门互补性的理论框架，为医疗人力资源规划理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利医疗政策制定者提供了供需预测数据，指出了培训项目改革的方向，为NRRP（国家复苏与韧性计划）中社区医疗建设提供了人力资源规划建议。

title: Hidden Profits, Lost Jobs? Tax Havens and Employment Decisions
affiliations: University College Dublin (UCD), Banque de France, Paris School of Economics (PSE) and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Hidden Profits, Lost Jobs? Tax Havens and Employment Decisions
detail.abstract: Despite their advantages, multinational enterprises (MNEs) receive significant criticism, particularly with regard to offshoring jobs and shifting profits abroad to avoid taxation. Using administrative data for the universe of Norwegian and French firms and workers, we link these two issues by documenting a negative relation between MNE investment in a tax haven and employment in the high-tax country. In particular, exploiting the 2006 European Court of Justice (ECJ) decision on the Cadbury-Schweppes case which upheld the use of EU tax havens, we are able to establish a causal link in which tax haven use lowers domestic employment by 6%. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the effects are mainly concentrated among high-skilled workers. We further link the employment changes to the substance requirements mandated by the ECJ's ruling and the secrecy inherent to tax havens.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用挪威和法国企业及工人的行政数据，发现跨国企业在避税天堂的投资与高税率国家的就业之间存在负相关关系。利用2006年欧洲法院对Cadbury-Schweppes案件的裁决作为外生冲击，研究发现使用避税天堂导致国内就业减少6%，且主要影响高技能工人。
AI.research_question: 跨国企业使用避税天堂是否会影响其在母国（高税率国家）的就业水平？
AI.motivation: 跨国企业因其离岸外包工作和将利润转移到避税天堂以避税而受到广泛批评，但这两者之间的因果关系尚未得到充分实证检验。研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨避税天堂使用对国内就业的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业避税理论、跨国公司理论以及劳动力市场理论，探讨避税天堂使用如何通过利润转移、投资决策和劳动力需求影响国内就业。
AI.method: 使用挪威和法国全部企业和工人的行政数据，采用双重差分法（DID），以2006年欧洲法院对Cadbury-Schweppes案件的裁决作为外生政策冲击，建立因果关系。
AI.findings: 1. 跨国企业使用避税天堂导致国内就业减少6%；2. 这种影响主要集中体现在高技能工人群体；3. 就业变化与欧洲法院裁决中的实质要求以及避税天堂的保密性特征相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证建立了避税天堂使用与国内就业之间的因果关系；2. 揭示了避税天堂使用对劳动力市场的异质性影响（特别是高技能工人）；3. 将企业避税行为与劳动力市场结果联系起来，拓展了相关理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于避税天堂监管对就业影响的实证依据；2. 帮助企业理解避税决策对劳动力配置的实际后果；3. 为工会和劳动者提供了关于避税天堂使用对就业影响的具体证据。

title: The Causal Effects of Tariff Uncertainty on Consumers' Macroeconomic Expectations and Spending Plans
affiliations: , Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: The Causal Effects of Tariff Uncertainty on Consumers' Macroeconomic Expectations and Spending Plans

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 26-05
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use a large-scale randomized controlled trial to study the causal effects of tariff beliefs on US consumers' macroeconomic expectations and spending plans. We find that it is important to distinguish between the first- and second-moment effects of tariff rate changes. Exogenous variation in tariff-level expectations and perceived future tariff uncertainty differentially affects consumers' expectations and perceived uncertainty about inflation, GDP growth, and unemployment. Furthermore, higher expectations of tariff rates induce an intertemporal substitution effect, increasing consumers' likelihood of buying durable goods. But higher tariff-rate uncertainty reduces consumers' readiness to spend on durable goods, consistent with precautionary saving motives.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模随机对照试验研究关税信念对美国消费者宏观经济预期和支出计划的因果效应，发现关税水平预期和关税不确定性的不同影响
AI.research_question: 关税信念如何因果性地影响美国消费者的宏观经济预期和支出计划？
AI.motivation: 理解关税政策变化对消费者行为和宏观经济预期的影响机制，特别是区分关税水平变化和关税不确定性的不同效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预期形成理论和消费理论，区分关税变化的一阶矩（水平）效应和二阶矩（不确定性）效应，结合跨期替代效应和预防性储蓄动机
AI.method: 采用大规模随机对照试验，通过外生变化操纵关税预期和关税不确定性，测量对消费者宏观经济预期和支出计划的影响
AI.findings: 1）关税水平预期和关税不确定性对消费者通胀、GDP增长和失业预期有不同影响；2）更高的关税预期通过跨期替代效应增加耐用消费品购买可能性；3）更高的关税不确定性通过预防性储蓄动机降低耐用消费品支出意愿
AI.theory_contributions: 1）区分关税政策的一阶矩和二阶矩效应；2）建立关税信念影响消费者行为的理论框架；3）揭示跨期替代和预防性储蓄在关税传导机制中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供关税政策影响消费者信心的实证证据；2）帮助企业理解关税不确定性对消费需求的影响；3）为宏观经济预测提供消费者预期形成机制的新视角

title: Do Machine-Readable Disclosures Fuel Nonbank Lending?
affiliations: , University of Zurich - Department Finance and University of Missouri at Columbia

detail.title: Do Machine-Readable Disclosures Fuel Nonbank Lending?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-18
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how reductions in public-information processing costs affect nonbank participation in syndicated loans. Exploiting the SEC's staggered introduction of machinereadable disclosures as an exogenous shock to information-processing costs, we find that lower costs increase nonbank participation but do not affect their likelihood of serving as lead arrangers. The effect is significant only among nonbanks without industry expertise. Reduced processing costs facilitate entry by new nonbanks but not banks. Following the shock, nonbanks rely less on relationship-based signals and more on standard financial metrics. Higher pre-loan automated EDGAR downloads predict greater nonbank participation, consistent with information-processing costs as the mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用SEC引入机器可读披露作为外生冲击，发现降低公共信息处理成本会增加非银行机构参与银团贷款，但仅限于缺乏行业专业知识的非银行机构，且不影响其担任牵头安排人的可能性。
AI.research_question: 公共信息处理成本的降低如何影响非银行机构参与银团贷款？
AI.motivation: 随着技术进步，公共信息处理成本显著下降，但这对金融市场参与者（特别是非银行机构）的参与行为有何影响尚不清楚。了解信息处理成本变化如何影响不同金融机构的贷款决策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理成本理论、金融中介理论、银团贷款市场参与决策理论
AI.method: 利用美国证券交易委员会（SEC）分阶段引入机器可读披露作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法（DID）等计量经济学方法分析非银行机构参与银团贷款的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 降低信息处理成本增加非银行机构参与银团贷款；2. 该效应仅存在于缺乏行业专业知识的非银行机构；3. 不影响非银行机构担任牵头安排人的可能性；4. 促进新非银行机构进入，但不影响银行参与；5. 非银行机构减少对关系信号的依赖，更多使用标准财务指标；6. 贷款前EDGAR自动下载量越高，非银行参与度越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证检验信息处理成本对非银行金融机构参与决策的影响；2. 揭示信息处理成本降低如何改变不同类型金融机构的比较优势；3. 为信息处理成本理论在金融中介领域的应用提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构设计信息披露政策提供参考；2. 帮助金融机构理解技术变革对竞争格局的影响；3. 为借款企业了解贷款市场参与者变化提供洞见。

title: The Protective Effects of a Healthy Spouse: Medicare as the Family Member of Last Resort
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Boston University, University of Toronto and University of Virginia

detail.title: The Protective Effects of a Healthy Spouse: Medicare as the Family Member of Last Resort

declarations.funderStatement: All findings, interpretations, and conclusions of this paper represent the views of the authors and does not represent official views of the above-named institutions. © 2025 Pension Research Council of the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. All rights reserved.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Wharton Pension Research Council Working Paper No. 24
publicationDetails.journalName: Wharton Pension Research Council / Boettner Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use novel Medicare data that link spouses to examine how one spouse's sudden incapacitation affects their partner's need for formal care. A spouse's health shock causes their partner to be 18% more likely to visit a skilled nursing facility. That pattern reflects both a change in health and a shift from informal care to formal care. After one spouse is incapacitated, the other spouse becomes less sensitive to the price of formal care. We explore the implications for optimal health insurance contracts, showing that these within-household spillovers imply that the optimal health insurance contract should provide more generous coverage to those whose spouses are incapacitated relative to those whose spouses are available to provide care.

AI.tldr: 研究使用配偶关联的Medicare数据发现，当一方配偶突然丧失自理能力时，另一方配偶使用专业护理设施的概率增加18%，这反映了健康变化和从非正式护理转向正式护理的双重效应。配偶健康冲击会降低另一方对正式护理价格的敏感性，从而影响最优健康保险合约设计。
AI.research_question: 配偶突然丧失自理能力如何影响另一方配偶对正式护理的需求？这种家庭内部溢出效应对最优健康保险合约设计有何启示？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭内部健康冲击的溢出效应对于设计有效的健康保险政策至关重要。现有研究较少关注配偶健康冲击如何影响另一方对正式护理的需求，以及这种家庭内部依赖关系对保险合约设计的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭内部护理决策理论，包括非正式护理与正式护理的替代关系、健康冲击的家庭溢出效应、以及保险合约设计中的道德风险和逆向选择理论。
AI.method: 使用新颖的Medicare数据，该数据能够关联配偶信息，通过实证分析配偶突然丧失自理能力对另一方使用专业护理设施的影响，并检验价格敏感性的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 配偶健康冲击使另一方使用专业护理设施的概率增加18%；2. 这种效应既反映了健康变化，也反映了从非正式护理向正式护理的转变；3. 配偶丧失自理能力后，另一方对正式护理价格的敏感性降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了家庭内部健康冲击的溢出效应机制；2. 扩展了非正式护理与正式护理替代关系的理论理解；3. 为考虑家庭依赖关系的最优保险合约设计提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为健康保险政策制定者提供实证依据，建议为配偶丧失自理能力的人提供更慷慨的保险覆盖；2. 帮助保险公司设计更精准的风险定价模型；3. 为长期护理政策设计提供家庭视角的参考。

title: Large and Deep Factor Models
affiliations: Yale SOM, Swiss Finance Institute, Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne, École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Large and Deep Factor Models

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-20
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show that a deep neural network (DNN) trained for stochastic discount factor (SDF) estimation admits a sharp additive decomposition that separates characteristics discovery from pricing rule estimation. The pricing-relevant component of this decomposition is governed by a new object, the Portfolio Tangent Kernel (PTK), which summarizes the features learned by the network and yields a linear factor representation for the SDF. In population, the PTKimplied SDF converges to a ridge-regularized version of the true SDF, where the effective degree of regularization is determined by the spectral complexity of the PTK. Using U.S. equity data, we show that the PTK representation delivers economically and statistically significant gains in SDF performance, but its spectral complexity has increased sharply over time-by roughly a factor of six since the early 2000s-coinciding with a deterioration in finite-sample pricing performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种深度神经网络（DNN）用于随机贴现因子（SDF）估计的新分解方法，将特征发现与定价规则估计分离，并引入了投资组合切线核（PTK）这一新概念来表征学习到的特征。
AI.research_question: 深度神经网络在随机贴现因子估计中如何分离特征发现与定价规则估计？投资组合切线核（PTK）如何表征学习到的特征并影响SDF性能？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型在特征发现和定价规则估计方面存在局限性，深度神经网络虽然能自动发现特征，但其内部工作机制不透明。需要理解DNN在SDF估计中的工作机制，特别是如何分离特征发现与定价规则，以及学习到的特征如何影响定价性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机贴现因子（SDF）理论、深度神经网络理论、核方法、岭回归正则化理论、谱复杂度理论。
AI.method: 提出深度神经网络的加性分解方法，分离特征发现与定价规则估计；引入投资组合切线核（PTK）作为表征学习特征的新对象；理论分析PTK隐含的SDF在总体中收敛到岭正则化版本的真正SDF；使用美国股票数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. PTK表示在SDF性能上带来经济和统计上显著的提升；2. PTK的谱复杂度随时间急剧增加（自2000年代初以来约增加6倍）；3. 谱复杂度的增加与有限样本定价性能的恶化同时发生。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了深度神经网络在SDF估计中的加性分解理论，分离特征发现与定价规则；2. 引入了投资组合切线核（PTK）这一新概念；3. 建立了PTK隐含SDF收敛到岭正则化SDF的理论框架；4. 揭示了谱复杂度与正则化程度的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解深度神经网络在资产定价中的工作机制提供了新视角；2. PTK表示可提高SDF估计性能；3. 谱复杂度的监测有助于评估模型过拟合风险；4. 为资产定价实践提供了更透明的特征发现和定价规则分离框架。

title: A New Tax Shelter Wave

detail.abstract: This paper describes the emergence of a new tax shelter wave and compares it to the two previous waves between 1970 and 1986 and 1987 to 2006.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了新一波避税浪潮的出现，并将其与1970-1986年和1987-2006年的前两波浪潮进行比较。
AI.research_question: 新一波避税浪潮的特征是什么？与前两波避税浪潮（1970-1986年和1987-2006年）相比有何异同？
AI.motivation: 避税行为对企业财务决策、税收政策和监管环境有重要影响。理解避税浪潮的演变模式有助于预测未来趋势，为政策制定者和监管机构提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于避税理论、监管套利理论、制度理论和企业财务理论，分析避税行为的驱动因素和演变机制。
AI.method: 历史比较分析，通过对三个时期（1970-1986年、1987-2006年、新浪潮）的避税案例、监管变化和企业行为进行对比研究。
AI.findings: 新避税浪潮在技术复杂性、国际化和数字化方面与前两波有显著差异，反映了监管环境变化、技术进步和全球化趋势的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了避税理论的时间维度分析，提出了避税浪潮的周期性演变框架，丰富了监管套利和制度变迁的理论理解。

detail.title: IPO Counterfeit Goods Wave 4

declarations.ethicsApproval: Written consent

detail.abstract:
This is the fourth wave of a survey of 5,000 UK adults (aged 18+). Those who completed the survey discussed their buying history and habits, including counterfeit goods. The survey covered six broad product categories:

  • beauty and hygiene
  • clothing, footwear and accessories
  • sports
  • toys
  • electricals

The report is supported by data tables, which provide figures and percentages for each chart.

The survey was developed in consultation with the relevant industry and trade bodies.

AI.tldr: 这是一项针对5000名英国成年人的第四次调查，研究消费者购买假冒商品的习惯和模式，涵盖六大产品类别。
AI.research_question: 英国消费者在不同产品类别中购买假冒商品的习惯和模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解消费者购买假冒商品的行为模式，为行业和贸易机构提供数据支持，打击假冒商品市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论，假冒商品购买决策模型，市场细分理论。

AI.findings: 调查提供了各产品类别中消费者购买假冒商品的详细数据和百分比，揭示了不同人群的购买习惯和模式。
