title: The Effect of Administrative Capacity in Public Procurement on Project Completion Times
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Effect of Administrative Capacity in Public Procurement on Project Completion Times

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 984
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this study, we use a large dataset documenting public works in Italy to examine how administrative capacity can shape the outcomes of procurement procedures. The analysis considers the duration of the three main phases – design, awarding, and execution. First, it shows substantial heterogeneity across contracting authorities in the length of these phases for projects that are similar in terms of observable characteristics. These differences in durations are strongly correlated with indicators of administrative quality. Second, the identity of the project manager (RUP) is also shown to play an important role. Observable characteristics – such as the RUP’s level of education or experience – explain only a limited share of the variation, highlighting the importance of unobservable factors such as tacit knowledge, effort and managerial skills. Third, in the execution phase, both contracting authorities and firms play a crucial role: completion times are shorter when works are awarded to more productive firms, and more capable project managers tend to select such firms more frequently.

AI.tldr: 本文使用意大利公共工程大数据，研究行政能力如何影响采购程序结果。分析显示：1) 不同发包机构在相似项目的设计、招标、执行阶段存在显著时间差异，与行政质量指标相关；2) 项目经理(RUP)身份起重要作用，可观测特征仅解释部分差异，隐性知识、努力和管理技能是关键；3) 执行阶段中，发包机构和承包商都重要：更高效企业完成时间更短，更有能力的项目经理更倾向选择这类企业。
AI.research_question: 行政能力如何影响公共工程采购程序的结果？具体而言，发包机构的行政质量、项目经理的特征以及承包商的生产力如何影响采购各阶段（设计、招标、执行）的持续时间？
AI.motivation: 公共工程采购效率对公共资源利用和基础设施建设至关重要。理解行政能力和管理因素如何影响采购程序的时间效率，有助于改进公共管理实践，提高公共支出效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共管理理论、组织能力理论和采购效率理论，关注行政质量、项目经理特征（人力资本、隐性知识、管理技能）和承包商生产力对采购程序效率的影响。
AI.method: 使用意大利公共工程的大规模数据集，分析设计、招标、执行三个阶段的持续时间。采用计量经济学方法，控制项目可观测特征，考察发包机构异质性、行政质量指标、项目经理特征（教育、经验）以及承包商生产力的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 相似项目在不同发包机构间存在显著时间差异，与行政质量指标强相关；2) 项目经理身份重要，但可观测特征仅解释部分差异，强调隐性知识、努力和管理技能的作用；3) 执行阶段中，更高效企业完成时间更短，更有能力的项目经理更倾向选择这类企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了行政能力对采购效率影响的理论理解；2) 强调了项目经理隐性特征（非可观测特征）的重要性；3) 揭示了发包机构与承包商互动对执行效率的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为公共机构改进采购效率提供实证依据；2) 强调项目经理选拔和培训的重要性；3) 建议优化承包商选择机制以提高执行效率；4) 为政策制定者提供改善行政能力的参考。

title: YYA Glossary | Coevolutionary Development: China as Demonstration
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: YYA Glossary | Coevolutionary Development: China as Demonstration

keywords: How China Escaped the Poverty Trap

detail.abstract: Coevolutionary Development: China as Demonstration is a theory introduced by Yuen Yuen Ang in How China Escaped the Poverty Trap (2016) that explains China’s development as a coevolutionary process in which states and markets mutually adapt and reshape one another over time, rather than by first establishing ideal or “good institutions” that conform to Western standards. Ang demonstrates her theory of Coevolutionary Development using reform-era China (1980s–2012) as a high-resolution empirical case, tracing how state–market relations coevolved across regions and sectors—including economic structure, property rights, development strategies, bureaucratic incentives, and corruption—through the systematic method of Mapping Coevolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"共同演化发展"理论，以中国改革开放时期（1980-2012）为案例，解释中国发展不是通过建立符合西方标准的"好制度"，而是通过国家与市场相互适应、重塑的共同演化过程。
AI.research_question: 中国如何摆脱贫困陷阱？国家与市场关系如何通过共同演化过程推动中国发展？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统发展理论认为需要先建立"好制度"（符合西方标准）才能发展的观点，解释中国发展的独特路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同演化发展理论（Coevolutionary Development），强调国家与市场相互适应、相互重塑的动态关系。
AI.method: 系统性的"映射共同演化"方法，以中国改革开放时期（1980-2012）为高分辨率实证案例，追踪跨区域和跨部门的国家-市场关系共同演化。
AI.findings: 中国的发展是通过国家与市场相互适应的共同演化过程实现的，涉及经济结构、产权、发展战略、官僚激励和腐败等多个方面的动态调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了替代传统制度主义的发展理论，强调制度与市场的共同演化而非线性因果关系，为理解非西方发展路径提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国及其他发展中国家提供了不同于西方模式的发展路径参考，强调因地制宜、渐进式改革的重要性。

title: Value-at-Risk: A Review of Selected Topics
affiliations: FRAME Consulting GmbH

detail.title: Value-at-Risk: A Review of Selected Topics

declarations.ethicsApproval: n.a.

detail.abstract: In this article we would like to examine three topics of practical importance that repeatedly occur in value-at-risk calculations: the prudent estimation of tail-quantiles using order statistics and two related questions dealing with quantile and time extrapolation of value-at-risk. All three topics are largely understood from a theoretical perspective, but in practice they do not always receive the attention they deserve. In particular, the use of a sample's order statistics to estimate a quantile is reviewed in depth. A novel method to correct the estimation bias is proposed. A specic use case for the situation discussed here is the internal capital adequacy assessment process (ICAAP). ICAAP's economic approach typically utilises a VaR at a very high condence level such as 99.9% and the need to perform a time scaling to a risk horizon of 1 year. The added value of this article lies in its coherent presentation of the three topics in the form of a reference manual that is detailed enough to be implemented directly. An advantage of the proposed method is that it requires only data that are already available from the standard valueat-risk calculation. Therefore, the core of a state-of-the-art value-at-risk model would generally remain untouched.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探讨了VaR计算中的三个实际问题：使用次序统计量审慎估计尾部百分位数、百分位数外推和时间外推，提出了一种修正估计偏差的新方法，特别适用于ICAAP中的高置信度VaR计算。
AI.research_question: 如何在价值风险（VaR）计算中准确估计尾部百分位数，并有效处理百分位数外推和时间外推问题？
AI.motivation: VaR计算中的尾部百分位数估计、百分位数外推和时间外推虽然理论上已有理解，但在实践中往往未得到足够重视，特别是在ICAAP等需要高置信度（如99.9%）VaR和一年风险期限的应用中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于次序统计量理论、极值理论、风险度量理论和统计推断理论，特别关注尾部风险量化和外推方法。
AI.method: 深入回顾使用样本次序统计量估计百分位数的方法，提出修正估计偏差的新方法，系统分析百分位数外推和时间外推问题，形成可直接实施的参考手册。
AI.findings: 提出了修正次序统计量估计偏差的新方法，该方法仅需标准VaR计算中已有的数据，无需改变现有VaR模型的核心结构，为ICAAP等高置信度VaR计算提供了实用解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统整合了VaR计算中的三个关键理论问题；2）提出了修正次序统计量估计偏差的新方法；3）为尾部风险量化提供了更严谨的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了可直接实施的参考手册；2）方法兼容现有VaR模型，无需重大改动；3）特别适用于ICAAP等监管要求的资本充足性评估；4）提高了高置信度VaR估计的准确性。

title: The Risk of Payment Card Fraud: An Analysis of the Italian Market over the Period 2015-24
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Risk of Payment Card Fraud: An Analysis of the Italian Market over the Period 2015-24

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 986
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study analyses developments in fraudulent transactions on payment cards in Italy over the period 2015 to 2024 and was conducted in the perspective of highlighting the risk to users of being victims of fraud, adopting a customer protection approach. Our results show that the fraud rate on individual payments has remained very low: today, fraud affects only 13 out of every 100,000 transactions, resulting in a loss of €18 for every €100,000 of payments. However, the growing use of payment cards has led to a significant increase in the likelihood of individuals experiencing fraud. The study proposes several indicators that approximate this risk. These have more than doubled over the period considered: fraudulent transactions now affect 2.9 per cent of the adult population, 1.2 per cent of payment cards in circulation, and 2.0 per cent of bank account holders. The risk of fraud is higher, on average, for clients of larger intermediaries compared with the rest of the system, probably because fraudsters are able access a wider pool of customers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2015-2024年意大利支付卡欺诈交易的发展趋势，从用户保护角度评估欺诈风险。结果显示单笔交易的欺诈率很低（每10万笔交易13笔），但支付卡的广泛使用使个人遭遇欺诈的可能性显著增加。研究提出了多个风险指标，这些指标在考察期间翻倍增长。
AI.research_question: 意大利支付卡欺诈交易在2015-2024年间的发展趋势如何？支付卡欺诈对用户的风险程度有多大？
AI.motivation: 从消费者保护角度出发，需要了解支付卡欺诈的发展趋势和用户面临的风险程度，为制定有效的风险防范措施提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护理论、支付系统风险管理理论、欺诈经济学理论
AI.method: 时间序列分析（2015-2024年）、统计指标计算、比较分析（不同规模金融机构对比）
AI.findings: 1. 单笔交易欺诈率很低：每10万笔交易13笔欺诈，损失率为每10万欧元支付损失18欧元；2. 个人遭遇欺诈风险显著增加：欺诈交易影响2.9%的成年人口、1.2%的流通支付卡、2.0%的银行账户持有人；3. 大型金融机构客户面临更高欺诈风险
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从消费者保护角度评估支付欺诈风险的理论框架，发展了多维度欺诈风险指标体系
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供欺诈风险监测指标；2. 为金融机构改进风险控制提供参考；3. 帮助消费者了解支付卡使用风险；4. 为制定消费者保护政策提供实证依据

title: Italian Households' Investments in Sovereign Securities in the Post-Pandemic Period
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Italian Households' Investments in Sovereign Securities in the Post-Pandemic Period

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 987
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Between 2022 and 2024, after a decade of subdued demand, Italian households significantly increased their direct purchases of sovereign securities (tdS), amounting to €195 billion. By the end of 2024, holdings of tdS reached €310 billion – around 5% of households’ financial assets – the highest share since 2013. Retail-targeted issues played a key role, accounting for about one-third of purchases. According to Banca d’Italia’s Household Outlook Survey, the percentage of households holding tdS rose to 15% (up from 6% in 2022), with 5% holding exclusively retail-targeted issues. Moreover, 12% of households reported an intention to purchase medium- and long-term government bonds (BTPs). Two probit analyses indicate that households investing a larger share of their financial assets in retail-targeted issues show a greater propensity to hold BTPs to maturity; holders of any type of tdS are 26 percentage points more likely to buy additional BTPs and, in a multivariate context, this likelihood increases with education and wealth.

AI.tldr: 2022-2024年间意大利家庭大幅增加主权证券直接购买，零售定向发行在其中起关键作用，持有者更倾向于持有至到期且更可能购买更多政府债券
AI.research_question: 意大利家庭在2022-2024年间大幅增加主权证券直接购买的原因是什么？哪些因素影响家庭持有这些证券至到期和进一步购买的意愿？
AI.motivation: 在经历了十年需求低迷后，意大利家庭突然大幅增加主权证券购买，这一现象值得研究，特别是零售定向发行在其中扮演的角色以及家庭投资行为的变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭投资行为理论、零售投资者行为、主权债务市场参与理论、行为金融学中的投资偏好和持有期限决策
AI.method: 使用意大利央行家庭展望调查数据，进行两项probit回归分析，研究家庭持有主权证券的特征、持有至到期的倾向以及进一步购买的意愿
AI.findings: 1. 2022-2024年意大利家庭购买1950亿欧元主权证券，持有量达3100亿欧元，占家庭金融资产5%；2. 零售定向发行占购买量的三分之一；3. 持有主权证券的家庭比例从6%升至15%；4. 投资零售定向发行比例较高的家庭更倾向于持有至到期；5. 持有任何类型主权证券的家庭购买更多政府债券的可能性高26个百分点；6. 教育程度和财富水平增加购买可能性
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对零售投资者在主权债务市场中行为的理解，揭示了家庭投资主权证券的动机和决策机制，特别是零售定向发行对投资行为的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府债务管理提供参考，特别是零售定向发行的有效性；为金融机构设计适合家庭投资者的产品提供依据；为政策制定者理解家庭金融行为提供实证证据

title: Who Is Paying for the 2025 U.S. Tariffs?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia University - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences - Department of Economics

detail.title: Who Is Paying for the 2025 U.S. Tariffs?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Over the course of 2025, the average tariff rate on U.S. imports increased from 2.6 to 13 percent. In this blog post, we ask how much of the tariffs were paid by the U.S., using import data through November 2025. We find that nearly 90 percent of the tariffs’ economic burden fell on U.S. firms and consumers.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/02/who-is-paying-for-the-2025-u-s-tariffs/

title: Intertwined Inequities in the Long-Term Care Economy
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh - School of Law

detail.title: Intertwined Inequities in the Long-Term Care Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicting interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

publicationDetails.detailsText: U. of Pittsburgh Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-05
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Pittsburgh School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This Article examines the profound disability- and race-based inequities embedded in the United States’ approach to financing long-term care. It argues that the lack of coherent coverage reflects not merely an insurance gap but a mechanism of structural discrimination that produces intersectional injustice, often impoverishing disabled persons who need long-term care and exacerbating racial and ethnic health disparities. Focusing primarily on Home- and Community-Based Services (HCBS), the Article documents how Medicaid’s mandatory coverage of nursing home care—contrasted with its optional and fragmented coverage of HCBS—impedes community integration and disproportionately harms people of color. Medicaid’s ‘rebalancing’ of its spending away from nursing home care and toward HCBS, a shift prompted in part by the Supreme Court’s decision in Olmstead v. L.C., is generally viewed as laudable. But emerging empirical research suggests that two decades of ‘rebalancing’ have benefited people of color less than White people. Filling a void in legal scholarship regarding these inequities, this work urges the need for future reforms to prioritize health equity. As demographic shifts augur an impending crisis in long-term care, the Article emphasizes that transformation of the American long-term care economy must move beyond filling insurance gaps to dismantle the structural inequities that impoverish disabled people and disproportionately neglect the needs of people of color.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美国长期护理融资体系中存在的残疾和种族不平等问题，指出这种不平等不仅是保险缺口，更是结构性歧视机制，导致交叉性不公，使需要长期护理的残疾人贫困化并加剧种族健康差异。
AI.research_question: 美国长期护理融资体系如何通过结构性歧视机制产生残疾和种族交叉性不平等？
AI.motivation: 美国长期护理融资体系缺乏连贯覆盖，这不仅是保险缺口，更是结构性歧视机制，导致残疾人和有色人种面临交叉性不公，随着人口老龄化，这一问题将演变为危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性歧视理论、交叉性理论（残疾与种族交叉）、健康公平理论
AI.method: 法律分析、政策文献分析、实证研究综述（特别是关于Medicaid"再平衡"政策的实证研究）
AI.findings: 1. Medicaid强制覆盖养老院护理而选择性覆盖HCBS阻碍社区融合；2. 尽管有Olmstead案推动的"再平衡"政策，但二十年来有色人种获益少于白人；3. 现有体系使残疾人贫困化并忽视有色人种需求
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了法律学术关于长期护理融资中残疾和种族不平等的研究空白，提出了结构性歧视和交叉性不公的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁未来改革优先考虑健康公平，建议美国长期护理经济转型必须超越填补保险缺口，致力于消除结构性不平等

title: FEATURE COMMENT: Governance as a "Blocker": How the Pentagon's New AI Strategy Trades Oversight for Speed
affiliations: George Washington University - Law School

detail.title: FEATURE COMMENT: Governance as a "Blocker": How the Pentagon's New AI Strategy Trades Oversight for Speed

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-12
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-12
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The Department of Defense's January 2026 AI Strategy memorandum presents governance and speed as a zero-sum tradeoff, labeling core oversight mechanisms such as ATOs, test and evaluation, and contracting processes as "blockers" to be waived through a newly established Barrier Removal Board. By doing so, the memo converts governance from a baseline into a negotiable exception. It also redefines "Responsible AI" in ways that depart from the Department's prior lifecycle-assurance framework, mandates "any lawful use" contract language that shifts risk management responsibility to the government, and elevates undefined criteria like "model objectivity" to primary procurement standards, without providing contracting officers a methodology for evaluating compliance. These changes unfold as the acquisition workforce is hollowed out through retirements, buyouts, and reductions in force, reducing the institutional capacity needed to exercise the very discretion the memo demands. The Feature Comment argues that the resulting gap between waiver authority and oversight capacity is not a policy choice but a procurement integrity risk, one that will compound as the acquisition workforce shrinks and institutional oversight erodes.

AI.tldr: 美国国防部2026年AI战略备忘录将治理与速度对立，通过建立"障碍消除委员会"削弱传统监管机制，重新定义"负责任AI"概念，并将风险管理责任转移给政府，同时采购人员减少导致监管能力不足，形成采购诚信风险。
AI.research_question: 美国国防部2026年AI战略备忘录中的治理框架变化如何影响采购诚信和风险管理？
AI.motivation: 国防部AI战略将治理与速度视为零和博弈，通过建立障碍消除委员会削弱传统监管机制，同时采购人员减少导致监管能力不足，形成系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论、风险管理理论、采购诚信理论、制度能力理论、监管例外主义
AI.method: 政策文件分析、制度分析、风险识别分析、文本分析
AI.findings: 备忘录将治理从基线转变为可协商例外；重新定义"负责任AI"偏离原有生命周期保障框架；"任何合法使用"合同条款将风险管理责任转移给政府；"模型客观性"等未定义标准成为主要采购标准；采购人员减少与监管要求增加形成矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"治理例外主义"概念；揭示监管能力与授权之间的脱节风险；构建采购诚信风险分析框架；探讨制度能力侵蚀对技术治理的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示国防部AI采购中的系统性风险；建议加强采购人员培训和保留；呼吁明确AI采购标准和评估方法；强调监管能力与授权匹配的重要性。

title: Competition and Fraud in Health Care
affiliations: Boston University, University of Utah, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Boston University, Washington University in St. Louis and Duke University

detail.title: Competition and Fraud in Health Care
detail.abstract: Governments rely on private firms to provide public goods and services. Although competition among these firms reduces prices and the costs of procurement, it has an ambiguous effect on fraud: competition can both dissipate the rents that attracted fraudulent firms to the market while at the same time reducing margins to the point where legitimate firms no longer remain viable. We study this tradeoff in the government’s procurement of durable medical equipment. Following Medicare’s switch from regulated prices to competitive bidding, we find that fraudulent firms’ cost advantage allowed them to gain market share as legitimate firms exited the market.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了政府采购中竞争对欺诈行为的影响。研究发现，当医疗保险从管制价格转向竞争性招标时，欺诈企业凭借成本优势获得了市场份额，而合法企业则退出市场。
AI.research_question: 政府采购中的竞争如何影响欺诈行为？竞争是否能在降低价格的同时减少欺诈，还是会导致合法企业退出而欺诈企业占据市场？
AI.motivation: 政府依赖私营企业提供公共产品和服务，竞争虽然能降低采购成本，但对欺诈行为的影响存在矛盾：竞争既能减少吸引欺诈企业的租金，也可能将利润率压得过低导致合法企业无法生存。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政府采购理论、竞争与欺诈的权衡理论、租金耗散理论、市场进入与退出理论
AI.method: 实证研究，利用医疗保险从管制价格转向竞争性招标的政策变化作为自然实验，分析耐用医疗设备采购市场的变化
AI.findings: 研究发现，竞争性招标实施后，欺诈企业凭借成本优势获得了市场份额，而合法企业则退出了市场。这表明竞争可能加剧了欺诈问题而非缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政府采购中竞争与欺诈之间的复杂关系，挑战了"竞争总是减少欺诈"的传统观点，提出了竞争可能导致"劣币驱逐良币"的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：在推行竞争性采购时需要考虑对欺诈行为的影响，可能需要配套的监管措施来防止合法企业被挤出市场
